ko.title: 2027년 세율 구간: 물가 조정이 내야 할 세금을 어떻게 바꾸는가

segments.src: Every autumn, the Internal Revenue Service publishes updated federal tax figures for the coming year.
segments.tr: 매년 가을, 미국 국세청(IRS)은 다음 해의 연방 세금 기준을 발표합니다.

segments.src: The announcement is routine, but it affects almost every household: the income thresholds for each tax bracket, the standard deduction, and the contribution limits for retirement accounts all shift.
segments.tr: 이 발표는 정례적인 것이지만, 거의 모든 가구에 영향을 미칩니다. 각 세율 구간의 소득 기준, 표준공제액, 퇴직연금 계좌의 납입 한도가 모두 바뀌기 때문입니다.

segments.src: This explainer covers how those inflation adjustments work, why they matter for your paycheck and retirement planning, and what to review before the year ends.
segments.tr: 이 해설에서는 이러한 물가 조정이 어떻게 작동하는지, 왜 급여와 노후 준비에 중요한지, 그리고 연말 전에 무엇을 점검해야 하는지 다룹니다.

segments.src: *Note: The IRS typically releases the next year's figures in October or early November.
segments.tr: *참고: IRS는 보통 다음 해의 기준을 10월 또는 11월 초에 발표합니다.

segments.src: At the time of writing, check IRS.gov for the official 2027 numbers.
segments.tr: 이 글을 쓰는 시점에는 IRS.gov에서 공식 2027년 수치를 확인하십시오.

segments.src: The 2026 figures cited below are used as a reference point and should be verified against current IRS guidance.*
segments.tr: 아래에 인용된 2026년 수치는 참고 기준으로만 사용되며, 최신 IRS 안내와 대조해 확인해야 합니다.*

segments.src: ## Why the IRS adjusts for inflation
segments.tr: ## 국세청이 물가에 맞춰 조정하는 이유

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 미국

segments.src: tax system uses a progressive structure: income is taxed in layers, and each layer has its own rate.
segments.tr: 세금 제도는 누진 구조를 씁니다. 소득이 여러 층으로 나뉘어 각 층마다 다른 세율이 적용됩니다.

segments.src: Without adjustments, rising prices and wages would slowly push taxpayers into higher brackets even when their purchasing power had not improved.
segments.tr: 조정이 없다면 물가와 임금이 오르는 것만으로도, 실질 구매력이 나아지지 않았는데도 납세자가 점차 더 높은 구간으로 밀려 올라가게 됩니다.

segments.src: This effect is commonly called "bracket creep."
segments.tr: 이 효과를 보통 "브라켓 크리프(bracket creep)"라고 부릅니다.

segments.src: To prevent it, federal law requires many tax parameters to be indexed to inflation each year.
segments.tr: 이를 막기 위해 연방법은 많은 세금 기준을 매년 물가에 연동하도록 정하고 있습니다.

segments.src: The IRS uses a price index, the chained Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (C-CPI-U), to calculate the changes.
segments.tr: IRS는 변동을 계산하기 위해 물가지수인 체인 소비자물가지수(C-CPI-U, 도시 지역 전체 소비자 대상)를 사용합니다.

segments.src: The result is that thresholds generally move up in line with measured price growth, which helps keep your tax burden tied to real income rather than nominal income.
segments.tr: 그 결과 기준금액은 대체로 측정된 물가 상승률에 맞춰 올라가며, 이는 세 부담이 명목 소득이 아니라 실질 소득에 맞춰 유지되도록 도와줍니다.

segments.src: ## What gets adjusted
segments.tr: ## 무엇이 조정되는가

segments.src: The annual update covers a long list of items.
segments.tr: 매년 조정 대상에는 긴 목록이 있습니다.

segments.src: The ones most households notice include:
segments.tr: 대부분의 가구가 체감하는 항목은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Tax bracket thresholds.** The income ranges for each marginal rate (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35% and 37%) move up. The rates themselves do not change through this process.
segments.tr: - **세율 구간 기준.** 각 한계세율(10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35%, 37%)의 소득 범위가 올라갑니다. 세율 자체는 이 과정을 통해 바뀌지 않습니다.

segments.src: - **The standard deduction.** For tax year 2026, the IRS set it at $16,100 for single filers and $32,200 for married couples filing jointly. Expect a modest increase for 2027.
segments.tr: - **표준공제.** 2026 과세연도의 표준공제액은 독신 신고자 $16,100, 부부 공동 신고자 $32,200으로 정해졌습니다. 2027년에는 소폭 인상될 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: - **Retirement contribution limits.** For 2026, the 401(k) employee deferral limit is $24,500, with higher catch-up amounts for older workers. IRA limits are adjusted as well, though in increments that depend on rounding rules.
segments.tr: - **퇴직연금 납입 한도.** 2026년 401(k) 근로자 이연 납입 한도는 $24,500이며, 고령 근로자에게는 추가 납입(catch-up) 한도가 더 높게 적용됩니다. IRA 한도도 조정되지만, 반올림 규칙에 따라 조정 폭이 달라집니다.

segments.src: - **Other items.** Income thresholds for certain credits, the Alternative Minimum Tax exemption, the annual gift tax exclusion, and flexible spending account limits are also indexed.
segments.tr: - **기타 항목.** 특정 세액공제의 소득 기준, 대체최저세(AMT) 면제액, 연간 증여세 공제액, 유연소비계좌(FSA) 한도도 물가에 연동됩니다.

segments.src: ## A simple example of how brackets work
segments.tr: ## 세율 구간이 작동하는 간단한 예

segments.src: Brackets are marginal.
segments.tr: 세율 구간은 한계(marginal) 방식입니다.

segments.src: Moving into a higher bracket does not mean all of your income is taxed at the higher rate.
segments.tr: 더 높은 구간으로 올라간다고 해서 모든 소득에 높은 세율이 적용되는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Only the income above the threshold is taxed at that rate.
segments.tr: 기준금액을 넘는 소득에만 그 세율이 적용됩니다.

segments.src: Suppose a bracket begins at $50,000 this year and, after indexing, begins at $51,500 next year.
segments.tr: 어떤 구간이 올해 $50,000에서 시작하고, 물가 조정 후 내년에는 $51,500에서 시작한다고 가정해 봅시다.

segments.src: A taxpayer with $51,000 of taxable income would see part of that income taxed at the lower rate in the new year that was taxed at the higher rate before.
segments.tr: 과세소득이 $51,000인 납세자는, 전에는 높은 세율이 적용되던 일부 소득에 새해부터 낮은 세율이 적용되는 것을 보게 됩니다.

segments.src: The effect on any one person is usually small, often tens or a few hundred dollars, but it adds up across a full year of paychecks.
segments.tr: 개인에게 미치는 영향은 보통 작아서 수십 달러 또는 수백 달러 수준이지만, 1년 치 급여를 합치면 차이가 쌓입니다.

segments.src: ## What it means for your paycheck
segments.tr: ## 급여에 미치는 영향

segments.src: Employers use IRS withholding tables to decide how much federal income tax to take from each paycheck.
segments.tr: 고용주는 IRS의 원천징수표를 사용해 매번 급여에서 연방 소득세를 얼마나 뗄지 정합니다.

segments.src: When the thresholds and standard deduction rise, those tables are updated, and your take-home pay may increase slightly, assuming your salary stays the same.
segments.tr: 기준금액과 표준공제가 오르면 이 표가 갱신되고, 급여가 그대로라면 실수령액이 약간 늘어날 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If you receive a raise that outpaces inflation, however, more of your income can still land in higher brackets.
segments.tr: 다만 물가 상승률을 웃도는 임금 인상을 받으면, 더 많은 소득이 여전히 높은 구간에 속할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Indexing protects you from inflation alone, not from real income growth.
segments.tr: 물가 연동은 물가 상승만으로부터 보호해 줄 뿐, 실질 소득 증가로부터 보호해 주지는 않습니다.

segments.src: A year with a large raise, a bonus, a side business, or investment gains can still change your overall tax picture.
segments.tr: 큰 폭의 임금 인상, 보너스, 부업, 투자 수익이 있는 해에는 전체 세금 구도가 여전히 달라질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What it means for 401(k) and retirement planning
segments.tr: ## 401(k)와 노후 준비에 미치는 영향

segments.src: Higher contribution limits give savers more room to defer income.
segments.tr: 더 높은 납입 한도는 저축하는 사람이 소득을 이연할 수 있는 여지를 넓혀 줍니다.

segments.src: Contributing more to a traditional 401(k) lowers your taxable income for the year, while Roth contributions do not give an upfront deduction but allow qualified withdrawals later without federal income tax.
segments.tr: 전통형 401(k)에 더 많이 납입하면 그해 과세소득이 줄어드는 반면, 로스(Roth) 납입은 즉시 소득공제를 주지 않지만 적격 인출 시 나중에 연방 소득세 없이 돈을 찾을 수 있게 해 줍니다.

segments.src: A few points worth considering:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 고려할 점은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Check your contribution percentage.** If your plan takes a percentage of pay, a raise or a higher limit may not change how much you actually save. If you want to use the full new limit, you may need to raise your election.
segments.tr: - **납입 비율을 확인하십시오.** 플랜이 급여의 일정 비율을 떼도록 설정되어 있다면, 임금 인상이나 한도 상향이 실제 저축액을 바꾸지 않을 수 있습니다. 새 한도를 모두 활용하려면 납입 선택을 올려야 할 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Know the catch-up rules.** Workers age 50 and older can contribute extra amounts, and recent rules provide an even larger catch-up for certain ages. Some higher earners may be required to make catch-up contributions as Roth. Ask your plan administrator how it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **추가 납입(catch-up) 규칙을 알아 두십시오.** 만 50세 이상 근로자는 추가 금액을 납입할 수 있으며, 최근 규정은 특정 연령대에 더 큰 추가 납입을 허용합니다. 일부 고소득자는 추가 납입분을 로스로 해야 할 수도 있습니다. 어떻게 적용되는지는 플랜 관리자에게 문의하십시오.

segments.src: - **Confirm your employer match.** Make sure you are contributing enough to receive the full match your employer offers, since that is typically the most valuable benefit in the plan.
segments.tr: - **고용주 매칭을 확인하십시오.** 보통 플랜에서 가장 가치 있는 혜택이므로, 고용주가 제공하는 매칭 금액을 전부 받을 만큼 충분히 납입하고 있는지 확인하십시오.

segments.src: ## What to check before year-end
segments.tr: ## 연말 전 점검 사항

segments.src: The new thresholds apply to the next tax year, but your current-year decisions still matter.
segments.tr: 새 기준은 다음 과세연도부터 적용되지만, 현재 연도의 결정도 여전히 중요합니다.

segments.src: A short checklist:
segments.tr: 간단한 체크리스트는 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Review your withholding.** Use the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator to see whether you are on track to owe or receive a refund, and update your Form W-4 if needed.
segments.tr: 1. **원천징수를 검토하십시오.** IRS 세금 원천징수 계산기(Tax Withholding Estimator)로 세금을 더 낼지 환급받을지 확인하고, 필요하면 W-4 양식을 갱신하십시오.

segments.src: 2. **Maximize or adjust retirement contributions.** Employer plan deferrals generally must be made by December 31. IRA contributions can usually be made until the tax filing deadline.
segments.tr: 2. **퇴직연금 납입을 최대화하거나 조정하십시오.** 고용주 플랜의 이연 납입은 보통 12월 31일까지 이루어져야 합니다. IRA 납입은 보통 세금 신고 기한까지 할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Use flexible spending accounts.** Some FSA balances are subject to use-it-or-lose-it rules, so check your plan's deadline and any carryover allowance.
segments.tr: 3. **유연소비계좌를 활용하십시오.** 일부 FSA 잔액은 "쓰지 않으면 소멸" 규칙의 적용을 받으므로, 플랜의 기한과 이월 허용 금액을 확인하십시오.

segments.src: 4. **Look at investment gains and losses.** Selling losing positions can offset gains. Consider the timing of any large sale.
segments.tr: 4. **투자 손익을 살펴보십시오.** 손실이 난 종목을 매도하면 이익을 상쇄할 수 있습니다. 큰 규모의 매도는 시점을 신중히 고려하십시오.

segments.src: 5. **Consider charitable giving.** If you itemize or use a donor-advised fund, year-end is a common time to plan donations.
segments.tr: 5. **기부를 고려하십시오.** 항목별 공제를 받거나 기부자 조언 펀드(donor-advised fund)를 이용한다면, 연말은 기부를 계획하기에 흔한 시기입니다.

segments.src: 6. **Estimate next year's income.** If you expect a major change, such as a new job, retirement, or a sale of property, consider how the new brackets may affect you.
segments.tr: 6. **내년 소득을 예상하십시오.** 이직, 은퇴, 부동산 매각 등 큰 변화가 예상된다면, 새 구간이 자신에게 어떤 영향을 줄지 따져 보십시오.

segments.src: 7. **Update estimated payments.** Self-employed workers and others with income not subject to withholding should check whether their fourth-quarter payment is on track.
segments.tr: 7. **예정 납부액을 갱신하십시오.** 자영업자나 원천징수 대상이 아닌 소득이 있는 사람은 4분기 납부가 제대로 진행되고 있는지 확인해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## Keep it in perspective
segments.tr: ## 전체 맥락에서 보기

segments.src: Inflation adjustments are not a tax cut or a tax increase.
segments.tr: 물가 조정은 세금 인하도 세금 인상도 아닙니다.

segments.src: They are designed to keep the tax system neutral against rising prices.
segments.tr: 상승하는 물가에 세금 제도가 중립을 유지하도록 설계된 장치입니다.

segments.src: Their practical effect is usually modest, but they matter most when you combine them with a clear view of your own income, deductions, and savings goals.
segments.tr: 실질적 효과는 보통 크지 않지만, 자신의 소득, 공제, 저축 목표를 명확히 파악한 상태에서 함께 고려할 때 가장 중요합니다.

segments.src: Because individual circumstances vary, consider speaking with a qualified tax professional before making major decisions.
segments.tr: 개인 사정은 저마다 다르므로, 중요한 결정을 내리기 전에 자격을 갖춘 세무 전문가와 상담하는 것을 고려하십시오.

segments.src: For official figures and guidance, rely on IRS.gov and the IRS announcement of the 2027 inflation adjustments when it is published.
segments.tr: 공식 수치와 안내는 IRS.gov와, 2027년 물가 조정이 발표되면 그 IRS 공지를 참고하십시오.

segments.tr: *이 글은 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 하며, 세무, 법률 또는 재무 조언이 아닙니다.*

zh.title: 2027年税率档位：通胀调整如何改变你的应纳税额

segments.src: Every autumn, the Internal Revenue Service publishes updated federal tax figures for the coming year.
segments.tr: 每年秋季，美国国税局（IRS）都会公布下一年度的联邦税务数据更新。

segments.src: The announcement is routine, but it affects almost every household: the income thresholds for each tax bracket, the standard deduction, and the contribution limits for retirement accounts all shift.
segments.tr: 这一公告属于例行事务，但几乎影响每个家庭：各税率档位的收入门槛、标准扣除额以及退休账户的缴存上限都会随之调整。

segments.src: This explainer covers how those inflation adjustments work, why they matter for your paycheck and retirement planning, and what to review before the year ends.
segments.tr: 本文将解释这些通胀调整的运作方式，它们对你的工资收入和退休规划为何重要，以及在年底前需要检查哪些事项。

segments.src: *Note: The IRS typically releases the next year's figures in October or early November.
segments.tr: *注：美国国税局通常会在10月或11月初发布下一年度的数据。

segments.src: At the time of writing, check IRS.gov for the official 2027 numbers.
segments.tr: 撰写本文时，请在 IRS.gov 上查看 2027 年的官方数字。

segments.src: The 2026 figures cited below are used as a reference point and should be verified against current IRS guidance.*
segments.tr: 下文引用的 2026 年数据仅作为参考基准，应以现行 IRS 指引为准进行核实。*

segments.src: ## Why the IRS adjusts for inflation
segments.tr: ## 为什么国税局要进行通胀调整

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 美国

segments.src: tax system uses a progressive structure: income is taxed in layers, and each layer has its own rate.
segments.tr: 税制采用累进结构：收入分层征税，每一层都有各自的税率。

segments.src: Without adjustments, rising prices and wages would slowly push taxpayers into higher brackets even when their purchasing power had not improved.
segments.tr: 如果不做调整，物价和工资的上涨会在购买力并未提高的情况下，把纳税人慢慢推入更高的税率档位。

segments.src: This effect is commonly called "bracket creep."
segments.tr: 这种效应通常被称为“档位爬升”（bracket creep）。

segments.src: To prevent it, federal law requires many tax parameters to be indexed to inflation each year.
segments.tr: 为防止这种情况，联邦法律要求许多税务参数每年按通胀指数进行调整。

segments.src: The IRS uses a price index, the chained Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (C-CPI-U), to calculate the changes.
segments.tr: 国税局使用一种价格指数，即城市消费者链式消费者价格指数（C-CPI-U）来计算调整幅度。

segments.src: The result is that thresholds generally move up in line with measured price growth, which helps keep your tax burden tied to real income rather than nominal income.
segments.tr: 结果是，各档门槛一般会随实际测得的价格增长而上调，这有助于让你的税负与实际收入挂钩，而不是与名义收入挂钩。

segments.src: ## What gets adjusted
segments.tr: ## 哪些内容会被调整

segments.src: The annual update covers a long list of items.
segments.tr: 年度更新涵盖大量项目。

segments.src: The ones most households notice include:
segments.tr: 大多数家庭会注意到的项目包括：

segments.src: - **Tax bracket thresholds.** The income ranges for each marginal rate (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35% and 37%) move up. The rates themselves do not change through this process.
segments.tr: - **税率档位门槛。** 各边际税率（10%、12%、22%、24%、32%、35% 和 37%）对应的收入区间会上调。税率本身不会因这一过程而改变。

segments.src: - **The standard deduction.** For tax year 2026, the IRS set it at $16,100 for single filers and $32,200 for married couples filing jointly. Expect a modest increase for 2027.
segments.tr: - **标准扣除额。** 2026 纳税年度，国税局将单身申报者的标准扣除额定为 16,100 美元，夫妻联合申报为 32,200 美元。预计 2027 年会有小幅增加。

segments.src: - **Retirement contribution limits.** For 2026, the 401(k) employee deferral limit is $24,500, with higher catch-up amounts for older workers. IRA limits are adjusted as well, though in increments that depend on rounding rules.
segments.tr: - **退休缴存上限。** 2026 年，401(k) 员工延税缴存上限为 24,500 美元，年长员工还可享受更高的补缴额度。IRA 上限也会调整，不过调整幅度取决于取整规则。

segments.src: - **Other items.** Income thresholds for certain credits, the Alternative Minimum Tax exemption, the annual gift tax exclusion, and flexible spending account limits are also indexed.
segments.tr: - **其他项目。** 某些税收抵免的收入门槛、替代最低税（AMT）的免税额、年度赠与税免税额以及弹性支出账户（FSA）的上限也都会按指数调整。

segments.src: ## A simple example of how brackets work
segments.tr: ## 档位运作的简单示例

segments.src: Brackets are marginal.
segments.tr: 税率档位是边际的。

segments.src: Moving into a higher bracket does not mean all of your income is taxed at the higher rate.
segments.tr: 进入更高档位并不意味着你的全部收入都按更高税率征税。

segments.src: Only the income above the threshold is taxed at that rate.
segments.tr: 只有超过门槛的那部分收入才按该档税率征税。

segments.src: Suppose a bracket begins at $50,000 this year and, after indexing, begins at $51,500 next year.
segments.tr: 假设某档今年从 50,000 美元开始，经指数调整后，明年从 51,500 美元开始。

segments.src: A taxpayer with $51,000 of taxable income would see part of that income taxed at the lower rate in the new year that was taxed at the higher rate before.
segments.tr: 一位应税收入为 51,000 美元的纳税人，会发现在新的一年里，原本按较高税率征税的部分收入，有一部分改按较低税率征税。

segments.src: The effect on any one person is usually small, often tens or a few hundred dollars, but it adds up across a full year of paychecks.
segments.tr: 对个人的影响通常不大，往往只有几十美元或几百美元，但在整年的工资发放中会累积起来。

segments.src: ## What it means for your paycheck
segments.tr: ## 对你的工资意味着什么

segments.src: Employers use IRS withholding tables to decide how much federal income tax to take from each paycheck.
segments.tr: 雇主会使用 IRS 预扣税表来决定每次发薪时应扣缴多少联邦所得税。

segments.src: When the thresholds and standard deduction rise, those tables are updated, and your take-home pay may increase slightly, assuming your salary stays the same.
segments.tr: 当门槛和标准扣除额上升时，这些预扣税表会随之更新，假设你的薪资不变，你的实拿工资可能会略有增加。

segments.src: If you receive a raise that outpaces inflation, however, more of your income can still land in higher brackets.
segments.tr: 不过，如果你获得的加薪幅度超过通胀，那么仍会有更多收入落入较高的税率档位。

segments.src: Indexing protects you from inflation alone, not from real income growth.
segments.tr: 指数调整只能保护你免受通胀的影响，无法保护你不受实际收入增长的影响。

segments.src: A year with a large raise, a bonus, a side business, or investment gains can still change your overall tax picture.
segments.tr: 如果某一年有大幅加薪、奖金、副业收入或投资收益，你的整体税务状况仍可能发生变化。

segments.src: ## What it means for 401(k) and retirement planning
segments.tr: ## 对 401(k) 和退休规划意味着什么

segments.src: Higher contribution limits give savers more room to defer income.
segments.tr: 更高的缴存上限让储蓄者有更多空间延迟纳税。

segments.src: Contributing more to a traditional 401(k) lowers your taxable income for the year, while Roth contributions do not give an upfront deduction but allow qualified withdrawals later without federal income tax.
segments.tr: 向传统 401(k) 多缴存，可以降低当年的应税收入；而 Roth 缴存不能立即抵税，但符合条件的提款在日后无需缴纳联邦所得税。

segments.src: A few points worth considering:
segments.tr: 以下几点值得考虑：

segments.src: - **Check your contribution percentage.** If your plan takes a percentage of pay, a raise or a higher limit may not change how much you actually save. If you want to use the full new limit, you may need to raise your election.
segments.tr: - **检查你的缴存比例。** 如果你的计划是按工资的百分比扣缴，加薪或更高的上限未必会改变你实际的储蓄金额。若想用满新的上限，你可能需要调高自己的缴存选择。

segments.src: - **Know the catch-up rules.** Workers age 50 and older can contribute extra amounts, and recent rules provide an even larger catch-up for certain ages. Some higher earners may be required to make catch-up contributions as Roth. Ask your plan administrator how it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **了解补缴规则。** 年满 50 岁的员工可以额外缴存，而近期的规定还为特定年龄段提供了更高的补缴额度。部分高收入者可能被要求以 Roth 方式进行补缴。请向你的计划管理人员咨询这些规则如何适用于你。

segments.src: - **Confirm your employer match.** Make sure you are contributing enough to receive the full match your employer offers, since that is typically the most valuable benefit in the plan.
segments.tr: - **确认雇主配比。** 请确保你的缴存额足以拿到雇主提供的全额配比，因为这通常是计划中最有价值的福利。

segments.src: ## What to check before year-end
segments.tr: ## 年底前需要检查的事项

segments.src: The new thresholds apply to the next tax year, but your current-year decisions still matter.
segments.tr: 新的门槛适用于下一个纳税年度，但你当前年度的决定依然重要。

segments.src: A short checklist:
segments.tr: 一份简短的清单：

segments.src: 1. **Review your withholding.** Use the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator to see whether you are on track to owe or receive a refund, and update your Form W-4 if needed.
segments.tr: 1. **检查你的预扣税额。** 使用 IRS 预扣税估算器（Tax Withholding Estimator）查看你是否会补税或退税，并在需要时更新 Form W-4。

segments.src: 2. **Maximize or adjust retirement contributions.** Employer plan deferrals generally must be made by December 31. IRA contributions can usually be made until the tax filing deadline.
segments.tr: 2. **最大化或调整退休缴存。** 雇主计划的延税缴存通常须在 12 月 31 日前完成。IRA 缴存一般可以持续到报税截止日。

segments.src: 3. **Use flexible spending accounts.** Some FSA balances are subject to use-it-or-lose-it rules, so check your plan's deadline and any carryover allowance.
segments.tr: 3. **使用弹性支出账户。** 部分 FSA 余额受“当年用完、否则作废”规则约束，因此请查看你的计划截止日期以及任何结转额度。

segments.src: 4. **Look at investment gains and losses.** Selling losing positions can offset gains. Consider the timing of any large sale.
segments.tr: 4. **查看投资盈亏。** 出售亏损持仓可以抵消收益。请考虑任何大额出售的时机。

segments.src: 5. **Consider charitable giving.** If you itemize or use a donor-advised fund, year-end is a common time to plan donations.
segments.tr: 5. **考虑慈善捐赠。** 如果你采用分项扣除或使用捐赠者建议基金（DAF），年底通常是规划捐款的常见时机。

segments.src: 6. **Estimate next year's income.** If you expect a major change, such as a new job, retirement, or a sale of property, consider how the new brackets may affect you.
segments.tr: 6. **预估明年的收入。** 如果你预计会有重大变化，例如换工作、退休或出售房产，请考虑新的税率档位可能如何影响你。

segments.src: 7. **Update estimated payments.** Self-employed workers and others with income not subject to withholding should check whether their fourth-quarter payment is on track.
segments.tr: 7. **更新预估税款。** 自雇人士以及其他收入不适用预扣的人，应检查第四季度的缴款是否按计划进行。

segments.src: ## Keep it in perspective
segments.tr: ## 客观看待

segments.src: Inflation adjustments are not a tax cut or a tax increase.
segments.tr: 通胀调整既不是减税，也不是加税。

segments.src: They are designed to keep the tax system neutral against rising prices.
segments.tr: 它们的设计目的是让税制在物价上涨时保持中性。

segments.src: Their practical effect is usually modest, but they matter most when you combine them with a clear view of your own income, deductions, and savings goals.
segments.tr: 它们的实际影响通常不大，但当你结合对自身收入、扣除项和储蓄目标的清晰判断时，它们就最为重要。

segments.src: Because individual circumstances vary, consider speaking with a qualified tax professional before making major decisions.
segments.tr: 由于每个人的情况各不相同，在做出重大决定前，请考虑咨询合格的税务专业人士。

segments.src: For official figures and guidance, rely on IRS.gov and the IRS announcement of the 2027 inflation adjustments when it is published.
segments.tr: 如需官方数据和指引，请以 IRS.gov 以及 2027 年通胀调整的 IRS 公告（待发布后）为准。

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and is not tax, legal, or financial advice.*
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息参考，不构成税务、法律或财务建议。*

hi.title: 2027 कर ब्रैकेट: मुद्रास्फीति समायोजन आपके देय कर को कैसे बदलते हैं

segments.src: Every autumn, the Internal Revenue Service publishes updated federal tax figures for the coming year.
segments.tr: हर शरद ऋतु में, Internal Revenue Service आने वाले वर्ष के लिए अद्यतन संघीय कर आंकड़े प्रकाशित करती है।

segments.src: The announcement is routine, but it affects almost every household: the income thresholds for each tax bracket, the standard deduction, and the contribution limits for retirement accounts all shift.
segments.tr: यह घोषणा नियमित होती है, लेकिन यह लगभग हर परिवार को प्रभावित करती है: हर कर ब्रैकेट की आय सीमाएँ, मानक कटौती, और सेवानिवृत्ति खातों की योगदान सीमाएँ, ये सभी बदलती हैं।

segments.src: This explainer covers how those inflation adjustments work, why they matter for your paycheck and retirement planning, and what to review before the year ends.
segments.tr: यह व्याख्या बताती है कि ये मुद्रास्फीति समायोजन कैसे काम करते हैं, आपके वेतन और सेवानिवृत्ति योजना के लिए ये क्यों मायने रखते हैं, और वर्ष समाप्त होने से पहले क्या जांचना चाहिए।

segments.src: *Note: The IRS typically releases the next year's figures in October or early November.
segments.tr: *नोट: IRS आमतौर पर अगले वर्ष के आंकड़े अक्टूबर या नवंबर की शुरुआत में जारी करती है।

segments.src: At the time of writing, check IRS.gov for the official 2027 numbers.
segments.tr: इस लेख के लिखे जाने के समय, आधिकारिक 2027 आंकड़ों के लिए IRS.gov देखें।

segments.src: The 2026 figures cited below are used as a reference point and should be verified against current IRS guidance.*
segments.tr: नीचे उल्लिखित 2026 के आंकड़े एक संदर्भ बिंदु के रूप में उपयोग किए गए हैं और इन्हें वर्तमान IRS दिशानिर्देशों से सत्यापित किया जाना चाहिए।*

segments.src: ## Why the IRS adjusts for inflation
segments.tr: ## IRS मुद्रास्फीति के लिए समायोजन क्यों करती है

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: अमेरिकी

segments.src: tax system uses a progressive structure: income is taxed in layers, and each layer has its own rate.
segments.tr: कर प्रणाली एक प्रगतिशील संरचना का उपयोग करती है: आय को परतों में कर लगाया जाता है, और हर परत की अपनी दर होती है।

segments.src: Without adjustments, rising prices and wages would slowly push taxpayers into higher brackets even when their purchasing power had not improved.
segments.tr: समायोजन के बिना, बढ़ती कीमतें और वेतन करदाताओं को धीरे-धीरे उच्च ब्रैकेट में धकेल देते, भले ही उनकी क्रय शक्ति में सुधार न हुआ हो।

segments.src: This effect is commonly called "bracket creep."
segments.tr: इस प्रभाव को आम तौर पर "ब्रैकेट क्रीप" (bracket creep) कहा जाता है।

segments.src: To prevent it, federal law requires many tax parameters to be indexed to inflation each year.
segments.tr: इसे रोकने के लिए, संघीय कानून के अनुसार कई कर मापदंडों को हर वर्ष मुद्रास्फीति से जोड़ना आवश्यक है।

segments.src: The IRS uses a price index, the chained Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (C-CPI-U), to calculate the changes.
segments.tr: IRS परिवर्तनों की गणना के लिए एक मूल्य सूचकांक का उपयोग करती है, chained Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (C-CPI-U)।

segments.src: The result is that thresholds generally move up in line with measured price growth, which helps keep your tax burden tied to real income rather than nominal income.
segments.tr: इसका परिणाम यह है कि सीमाएँ आम तौर पर मापी गई मूल्य वृद्धि के अनुरूप ऊपर जाती हैं, जो आपके कर बोझ को नाममात्र आय के बजाय वास्तविक आय से जोड़े रखने में मदद करता है।

segments.src: ## What gets adjusted
segments.tr: ## क्या समायोजित होता है

segments.src: The annual update covers a long list of items.
segments.tr: वार्षिक अद्यतन में कई मदें शामिल होती हैं।

segments.src: The ones most households notice include:
segments.tr: जिन्हें अधिकांश परिवार सबसे अधिक नोटिस करते हैं, उनमें शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - **Tax bracket thresholds.** The income ranges for each marginal rate (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35% and 37%) move up. The rates themselves do not change through this process.
segments.tr: - **कर ब्रैकेट सीमाएँ।** हर सीमांत दर (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35% और 37%) के लिए आय सीमाएँ ऊपर जाती हैं। इस प्रक्रिया से दरें स्वयं नहीं बदलतीं।

segments.src: - **The standard deduction.** For tax year 2026, the IRS set it at $16,100 for single filers and $32,200 for married couples filing jointly. Expect a modest increase for 2027.
segments.tr: - **मानक कटौती।** कर वर्ष 2026 के लिए, IRS ने इसे एकल फाइलर्स के लिए $16,100 और संयुक्त रूप से फाइल करने वाले विवाहित जोड़ों के लिए $32,200 तय किया। 2027 के लिए मामूली वृद्धि की उम्मीद करें।

segments.src: - **Retirement contribution limits.** For 2026, the 401(k) employee deferral limit is $24,500, with higher catch-up amounts for older workers. IRA limits are adjusted as well, though in increments that depend on rounding rules.
segments.tr: - **सेवानिवृत्ति योगदान सीमाएँ।** 2026 के लिए, 401(k) कर्मचारी आस्थगन सीमा $24,500 है, जिसमें अधिक उम्र के कामगारों के लिए अधिक कैच-अप राशि है। IRA सीमाएँ भी समायोजित होती हैं, हालांकि यह वृद्धि गोलीकरण नियमों पर निर्भर वृद्धि में होती है।

segments.src: - **Other items.** Income thresholds for certain credits, the Alternative Minimum Tax exemption, the annual gift tax exclusion, and flexible spending account limits are also indexed.
segments.tr: - **अन्य मदें।** कुछ क्रेडिट की आय सीमाएँ, Alternative Minimum Tax छूट, वार्षिक उपहार कर अपवर्जन, और flexible spending account (FSA) की सीमाएँ भी सूचकांकित होती हैं।

segments.src: ## A simple example of how brackets work
segments.tr: ## ब्रैकेट कैसे काम करते हैं, इसका एक सरल उदाहरण

segments.src: Brackets are marginal.
segments.tr: ब्रैकेट सीमांत होते हैं।

segments.src: Moving into a higher bracket does not mean all of your income is taxed at the higher rate.
segments.tr: उच्च ब्रैकेट में जाने का अर्थ यह नहीं है कि आपकी सारी आय उच्च दर से कर योग्य होगी।

segments.src: Only the income above the threshold is taxed at that rate.
segments.tr: केवल सीमा से ऊपर की आय उस दर से कर योग्य होती है।

segments.src: Suppose a bracket begins at $50,000 this year and, after indexing, begins at $51,500 next year.
segments.tr: मान लीजिए एक ब्रैकेट इस वर्ष $50,000 से शुरू होता है और समायोजन के बाद अगले वर्ष $51,500 से शुरू होता है।

segments.src: A taxpayer with $51,000 of taxable income would see part of that income taxed at the lower rate in the new year that was taxed at the higher rate before.
segments.tr: $51,000 की कर योग्य आय वाले करदाता के लिए, उस आय का कुछ हिस्सा नए वर्ष में कम दर पर कर योग्य होगा, जबकि पहले वह उच्च दर पर कर योग्य था।

segments.src: The effect on any one person is usually small, often tens or a few hundred dollars, but it adds up across a full year of paychecks.
segments.tr: किसी एक व्यक्ति पर इसका प्रभाव आमतौर पर छोटा होता है, अक्सर दसियों या कुछ सौ डॉलर, लेकिन पूरे वर्ष के वेतन में यह जुड़ता जाता है।

segments.src: ## What it means for your paycheck
segments.tr: ## आपके वेतन के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: Employers use IRS withholding tables to decide how much federal income tax to take from each paycheck.
segments.tr: नियोक्ता हर वेतन से कितना संघीय आयकर काटना है, यह तय करने के लिए IRS की वेतन-कटौती तालिकाओं का उपयोग करते हैं।

segments.src: When the thresholds and standard deduction rise, those tables are updated, and your take-home pay may increase slightly, assuming your salary stays the same.
segments.tr: जब सीमाएँ और मानक कटौती बढ़ती हैं, तो वे तालिकाएँ अद्यतन की जाती हैं, और यदि आपका वेतन वही रहता है, तो आपका हाथ में आने वाला वेतन थोड़ा बढ़ सकता है।

segments.src: If you receive a raise that outpaces inflation, however, more of your income can still land in higher brackets.
segments.tr: हालांकि, यदि आपको मुद्रास्फीति से अधिक वेतन वृद्धि मिलती है, तो फिर भी आपकी अधिक आय उच्च ब्रैकेट में जा सकती है।

segments.src: Indexing protects you from inflation alone, not from real income growth.
segments.tr: समायोजन आपको केवल मुद्रास्फीति से बचाता है, वास्तविक आय वृद्धि से नहीं।

segments.src: A year with a large raise, a bonus, a side business, or investment gains can still change your overall tax picture.
segments.tr: बड़ी वेतन वृद्धि, बोनस, साइड बिज़नेस या निवेश लाभ वाला वर्ष भी आपकी समग्र कर तस्वीर बदल सकता है।

segments.src: ## What it means for 401(k) and retirement planning
segments.tr: ## 401(k) और सेवानिवृत्ति योजना के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: Higher contribution limits give savers more room to defer income.
segments.tr: उच्च योगदान सीमाएँ बचतकर्ताओं को आय आस्थगित करने के लिए अधिक गुंजाइश देती हैं।

segments.src: Contributing more to a traditional 401(k) lowers your taxable income for the year, while Roth contributions do not give an upfront deduction but allow qualified withdrawals later without federal income tax.
segments.tr: पारंपरिक 401(k) में अधिक योगदान करने से उस वर्ष की आपकी कर योग्य आय कम होती है, जबकि Roth योगदान पर अग्रिम कटौती नहीं मिलती, लेकिन बाद में योग्य निकासी पर संघीय आयकर नहीं लगता।

segments.src: A few points worth considering:
segments.tr: कुछ बिंदु विचार करने योग्य हैं:

segments.src: - **Check your contribution percentage.** If your plan takes a percentage of pay, a raise or a higher limit may not change how much you actually save. If you want to use the full new limit, you may need to raise your election.
segments.tr: - **अपना योगदान प्रतिशत जांचें।** यदि आपकी योजना वेतन का एक प्रतिशत लेती है, तो वेतन वृद्धि या उच्च सीमा से वास्तव में आप जितनी बचत करते हैं, वह न बदले। यदि आप नई पूरी सीमा का उपयोग करना चाहते हैं, तो आपको अपना चुनाव बढ़ाना पड़ सकता है।

segments.src: - **Know the catch-up rules.** Workers age 50 and older can contribute extra amounts, and recent rules provide an even larger catch-up for certain ages. Some higher earners may be required to make catch-up contributions as Roth. Ask your plan administrator how it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **कैच-अप नियम जानें।** 50 वर्ष और उससे अधिक उम्र के कामगार अतिरिक्त राशि योगदान कर सकते हैं, और हाल के नियम कुछ आयु वर्गों के लिए और भी बड़ा कैच-अप देते हैं। कुछ उच्च आय वाले लोगों को कैच-अप योगदान Roth के रूप में करने की आवश्यकता हो सकती है। यह आप पर कैसे लागू होता है, यह अपने योजना प्रशासक से पूछें।

segments.src: - **Confirm your employer match.** Make sure you are contributing enough to receive the full match your employer offers, since that is typically the most valuable benefit in the plan.
segments.tr: - **नियोक्ता मिलान की पुष्टि करें।** सुनिश्चित करें कि आप अपने नियोक्ता द्वारा दिया जाने वाला पूरा मिलान पाने के लिए पर्याप्त योगदान कर रहे हैं, क्योंकि आम तौर पर यही योजना का सबसे मूल्यवान लाभ होता है।

segments.src: ## What to check before year-end
segments.tr: ## वर्ष समाप्त होने से पहले क्या जांचें

segments.src: The new thresholds apply to the next tax year, but your current-year decisions still matter.
segments.tr: नई सीमाएँ अगले कर वर्ष पर लागू होती हैं, लेकिन आपके वर्तमान वर्ष के निर्णय अब भी मायने रखते हैं।

segments.src: A short checklist:
segments.tr: एक संक्षिप्त चेकलिस्ट:

segments.src: 1. **Review your withholding.** Use the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator to see whether you are on track to owe or receive a refund, and update your Form W-4 if needed.
segments.tr: 1. **अपनी वेतन-कटौती (withholding) की समीक्षा करें।** यह देखने के लिए IRS Tax Withholding Estimator का उपयोग करें कि क्या आप बकाया देने या रिफंड पाने की ओर जा रहे हैं, और ज़रूरत हो तो अपना Form W-4 अपडेट करें।

segments.src: 2. **Maximize or adjust retirement contributions.** Employer plan deferrals generally must be made by December 31. IRA contributions can usually be made until the tax filing deadline.
segments.tr: 2. **सेवानिवृत्ति योगदान अधिकतम करें या समायोजित करें।** नियोक्ता योजना के आस्थगन आम तौर पर 31 दिसंबर तक करने होते हैं। IRA योगदान आम तौर पर कर फाइलिंग की अंतिम तिथि तक किए जा सकते हैं।

segments.src: 3. **Use flexible spending accounts.** Some FSA balances are subject to use-it-or-lose-it rules, so check your plan's deadline and any carryover allowance.
segments.tr: 3. **लचीले खर्च खातों का उपयोग करें।** कुछ FSA शेष "उपयोग करो या खो दो" नियमों के अधीन होते हैं, इसलिए अपनी योजना की समय-सीमा और किसी भी कैरीओवर भत्ते की जांच करें।

segments.src: 4. **Look at investment gains and losses.** Selling losing positions can offset gains. Consider the timing of any large sale.
segments.tr: 4. **निवेश लाभ और हानि देखें।** घाटे वाली स्थितियाँ बेचने से लाभ की भरपाई हो सकती है। किसी बड़ी बिक्री के समय पर विचार करें।

segments.src: 5. **Consider charitable giving.** If you itemize or use a donor-advised fund, year-end is a common time to plan donations.
segments.tr: 5. **धर्मार्थ दान पर विचार करें।** यदि आप विवरण-सहित कटौती (itemize) करते हैं या donor-advised fund का उपयोग करते हैं, तो वर्ष का अंत दान की योजना बनाने का एक आम समय है।

segments.src: 6. **Estimate next year's income.** If you expect a major change, such as a new job, retirement, or a sale of property, consider how the new brackets may affect you.
segments.tr: 6. **अगले वर्ष की आय का अनुमान लगाएँ।** यदि आप किसी बड़े बदलाव की उम्मीद करते हैं, जैसे नई नौकरी, सेवानिवृत्ति, या संपत्ति की बिक्री, तो विचार करें कि नए ब्रैकेट आपको कैसे प्रभावित कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: 7. **Update estimated payments.** Self-employed workers and others with income not subject to withholding should check whether their fourth-quarter payment is on track.
segments.tr: 7. **अनुमानित भुगतान अपडेट करें।** स्व-नियोजित कामगारों और ऐसी आय वाले अन्य लोगों को, जिन पर वेतन-कटौती लागू नहीं होती, जांचना चाहिए कि उनका चौथी तिमाही का भुगतान सही दिशा में है या नहीं।

segments.src: ## Keep it in perspective
segments.tr: ## इसे परिप्रेक्ष्य में रखें

segments.src: Inflation adjustments are not a tax cut or a tax increase.
segments.tr: मुद्रास्फीति समायोजन कर में कटौती या कर वृद्धि नहीं हैं।

segments.src: They are designed to keep the tax system neutral against rising prices.
segments.tr: इन्हें बढ़ती कीमतों के सामने कर प्रणाली को तटस्थ रखने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।

segments.src: Their practical effect is usually modest, but they matter most when you combine them with a clear view of your own income, deductions, and savings goals.
segments.tr: इनका व्यावहारिक प्रभाव आमतौर पर मामूली होता है, लेकिन जब आप इन्हें अपनी आय, कटौतियों और बचत लक्ष्यों की स्पष्ट समझ के साथ जोड़ते हैं, तब ये सबसे अधिक मायने रखते हैं।

segments.src: Because individual circumstances vary, consider speaking with a qualified tax professional before making major decisions.
segments.tr: चूंकि व्यक्तिगत परिस्थितियाँ अलग-अलग होती हैं, बड़े निर्णय लेने से पहले किसी योग्य कर पेशेवर से बात करने पर विचार करें।

segments.src: For official figures and guidance, rely on IRS.gov and the IRS announcement of the 2027 inflation adjustments when it is published.
segments.tr: आधिकारिक आंकड़ों और दिशानिर्देशों के लिए, 2027 मुद्रास्फीति समायोजन की IRS घोषणा प्रकाशित होने पर IRS.gov और उस घोषणा पर भरोसा करें।

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and is not tax, legal, or financial advice.*
segments.tr: *यह लेख केवल सामान्य सूचना के उद्देश्य से है और कर, कानूनी या वित्तीय सलाह नहीं है।*

es.title: Tramos de impuestos 2027: cómo los ajustes por inflación cambian lo que debe pagar

segments.src: Every autumn, the Internal Revenue Service publishes updated federal tax figures for the coming year.
segments.tr: Cada otoño, el Servicio de Impuestos Internos (IRS) publica las cifras fiscales federales actualizadas para el año siguiente.

segments.src: The announcement is routine, but it affects almost every household: the income thresholds for each tax bracket, the standard deduction, and the contribution limits for retirement accounts all shift.
segments.tr: El anuncio es rutinario, pero afecta a casi todos los hogares: los umbrales de ingresos de cada tramo impositivo, la deducción estándar y los límites de aportación a las cuentas de jubilación cambian.

segments.src: This explainer covers how those inflation adjustments work, why they matter for your paycheck and retirement planning, and what to review before the year ends.
segments.tr: Esta explicación aborda cómo funcionan esos ajustes por inflación, por qué importan para su nómina y su planificación de la jubilación, y qué revisar antes de que termine el año.

segments.src: *Note: The IRS typically releases the next year's figures in October or early November.
segments.tr: *Nota: El IRS normalmente publica las cifras del año siguiente en octubre o a principios de noviembre.

segments.src: At the time of writing, check IRS.gov for the official 2027 numbers.
segments.tr: En el momento de redactar este texto, consulte IRS.gov para conocer las cifras oficiales de 2027.

segments.src: The 2026 figures cited below are used as a reference point and should be verified against current IRS guidance.*
segments.tr: Las cifras de 2026 que se citan a continuación se usan como punto de referencia y deben verificarse con la guía vigente del IRS.*

segments.src: ## Why the IRS adjusts for inflation
segments.tr: ## Por qué el IRS ajusta por inflación

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: El sistema tributario de EE. UU.

segments.src: tax system uses a progressive structure: income is taxed in layers, and each layer has its own rate.
segments.tr: utiliza una estructura progresiva: los ingresos se gravan por capas, y cada capa tiene su propio tipo.

segments.src: Without adjustments, rising prices and wages would slowly push taxpayers into higher brackets even when their purchasing power had not improved.
segments.tr: Sin ajustes, el aumento de precios y salarios empujaría poco a poco a los contribuyentes a tramos más altos aunque su poder adquisitivo no hubiera mejorado.

segments.src: This effect is commonly called "bracket creep."
segments.tr: Este efecto se conoce comúnmente como «bracket creep» (deslizamiento de tramos).

segments.src: To prevent it, federal law requires many tax parameters to be indexed to inflation each year.
segments.tr: Para evitarlo, la ley federal exige que muchos parámetros fiscales se indexen a la inflación cada año.

segments.src: The IRS uses a price index, the chained Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (C-CPI-U), to calculate the changes.
segments.tr: El IRS utiliza un índice de precios, el índice de precios al consumidor encadenado para todos los consumidores urbanos (C-CPI-U), para calcular los cambios.

segments.src: The result is that thresholds generally move up in line with measured price growth, which helps keep your tax burden tied to real income rather than nominal income.
segments.tr: El resultado es que los umbrales generalmente suben en línea con el crecimiento de precios medido, lo que ayuda a que su carga fiscal siga ligada al ingreso real y no al nominal.

segments.src: ## What gets adjusted
segments.tr: ## Qué se ajusta

segments.src: The annual update covers a long list of items.
segments.tr: La actualización anual abarca una larga lista de elementos.

segments.src: The ones most households notice include:
segments.tr: Los que más notan la mayoría de los hogares son:

segments.src: - **Tax bracket thresholds.** The income ranges for each marginal rate (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35% and 37%) move up. The rates themselves do not change through this process.
segments.tr: - **Umbrales de los tramos impositivos.** Los rangos de ingresos de cada tipo marginal (10 %, 12 %, 22 %, 24 %, 32 %, 35 % y 37 %) suben. Los tipos en sí no cambian con este proceso.

segments.src: - **The standard deduction.** For tax year 2026, the IRS set it at $16,100 for single filers and $32,200 for married couples filing jointly. Expect a modest increase for 2027.
segments.tr: - **La deducción estándar.** Para el año fiscal 2026, el IRS la fijó en $16,100 para los contribuyentes solteros y en $32,200 para los matrimonios que presentan declaración conjunta. Se espera un aumento moderado para 2027.

segments.src: - **Retirement contribution limits.** For 2026, the 401(k) employee deferral limit is $24,500, with higher catch-up amounts for older workers. IRA limits are adjusted as well, though in increments that depend on rounding rules.
segments.tr: - **Límites de aportación a la jubilación.** Para 2026, el límite de aportación del empleado al 401(k) es de $24,500, con importes adicionales de recuperación (catch-up) más altos para los trabajadores de mayor edad. Los límites de los IRA también se ajustan, aunque en incrementos que dependen de las reglas de redondeo.

segments.src: - **Other items.** Income thresholds for certain credits, the Alternative Minimum Tax exemption, the annual gift tax exclusion, and flexible spending account limits are also indexed.
segments.tr: - **Otros elementos.** Los umbrales de ingresos para ciertos créditos, la exención del Impuesto Mínimo Alternativo, la exclusión anual del impuesto sobre donaciones y los límites de las cuentas de gastos flexibles (FSA) también se indexan.

segments.src: ## A simple example of how brackets work
segments.tr: ## Un ejemplo sencillo de cómo funcionan los tramos

segments.src: Brackets are marginal.
segments.tr: Los tramos son marginales.

segments.src: Moving into a higher bracket does not mean all of your income is taxed at the higher rate.
segments.tr: Pasar a un tramo superior no significa que todos sus ingresos tributen a la tasa más alta.

segments.src: Only the income above the threshold is taxed at that rate.
segments.tr: Solo los ingresos por encima del umbral tributan a esa tasa.

segments.src: Suppose a bracket begins at $50,000 this year and, after indexing, begins at $51,500 next year.
segments.tr: Supongamos que un tramo empieza en $50,000 este año y, tras la indexación, empieza en $51,500 el próximo año.

segments.src: A taxpayer with $51,000 of taxable income would see part of that income taxed at the lower rate in the new year that was taxed at the higher rate before.
segments.tr: Un contribuyente con $51,000 de renta imponible vería que parte de esa renta, que antes tributaba a la tasa más alta, en el nuevo año tributa a la más baja.

segments.src: The effect on any one person is usually small, often tens or a few hundred dollars, but it adds up across a full year of paychecks.
segments.tr: El efecto sobre cada persona suele ser pequeño, a menudo de decenas o unos pocos cientos de dólares, pero se acumula a lo largo de todo un año de nóminas.

segments.src: ## What it means for your paycheck
segments.tr: ## Qué significa para su nómina

segments.src: Employers use IRS withholding tables to decide how much federal income tax to take from each paycheck.
segments.tr: Los empleadores utilizan las tablas de retención del IRS para decidir cuánto impuesto federal sobre la renta retener de cada nómina.

segments.src: When the thresholds and standard deduction rise, those tables are updated, and your take-home pay may increase slightly, assuming your salary stays the same.
segments.tr: Cuando suben los umbrales y la deducción estándar, esas tablas se actualizan, y su salario neto puede aumentar ligeramente, suponiendo que su sueldo no cambie.

segments.src: If you receive a raise that outpaces inflation, however, more of your income can still land in higher brackets.
segments.tr: Si recibe un aumento salarial que supera la inflación, sin embargo, una mayor parte de sus ingresos puede seguir cayendo en tramos más altos.

segments.src: Indexing protects you from inflation alone, not from real income growth.
segments.tr: La indexación le protege de la inflación por sí sola, no del crecimiento real de los ingresos.

segments.src: A year with a large raise, a bonus, a side business, or investment gains can still change your overall tax picture.
segments.tr: Un año con un aumento importante, una prima, un negocio secundario o ganancias de inversión puede seguir cambiando su panorama fiscal general.

segments.src: ## What it means for 401(k) and retirement planning
segments.tr: ## Qué significa para el 401(k) y la planificación de la jubilación

segments.src: Higher contribution limits give savers more room to defer income.
segments.tr: Los límites de aportación más altos dan a los ahorradores más margen para diferir ingresos.

segments.src: Contributing more to a traditional 401(k) lowers your taxable income for the year, while Roth contributions do not give an upfront deduction but allow qualified withdrawals later without federal income tax.
segments.tr: Aportar más a un 401(k) tradicional reduce su renta imponible del año, mientras que las aportaciones Roth no dan una deducción inmediata, pero permiten retiros cualificados posteriores sin impuesto federal sobre la renta.

segments.src: A few points worth considering:
segments.tr: Algunos puntos que vale la pena considerar:

segments.src: - **Check your contribution percentage.** If your plan takes a percentage of pay, a raise or a higher limit may not change how much you actually save. If you want to use the full new limit, you may need to raise your election.
segments.tr: - **Revise su porcentaje de aportación.** Si su plan retiene un porcentaje del salario, un aumento o un límite más alto puede no cambiar cuánto ahorra realmente. Si quiere usar el nuevo límite completo, es posible que deba aumentar su elección.

segments.src: - **Know the catch-up rules.** Workers age 50 and older can contribute extra amounts, and recent rules provide an even larger catch-up for certain ages. Some higher earners may be required to make catch-up contributions as Roth. Ask your plan administrator how it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **Conozca las reglas de recuperación (catch-up).** Los trabajadores de 50 años o más pueden aportar importes extra, y las normas recientes prevén una recuperación aún mayor para ciertas edades. Algunos contribuyentes de mayores ingresos pueden estar obligados a hacer las aportaciones de recuperación en Roth. Consulte con el administrador de su plan cómo se aplica a usted.

segments.src: - **Confirm your employer match.** Make sure you are contributing enough to receive the full match your employer offers, since that is typically the most valuable benefit in the plan.
segments.tr: - **Confirme la contrapartida de su empleador.** Asegúrese de aportar lo suficiente para recibir la contrapartida completa que ofrece su empleador, ya que suele ser el beneficio más valioso del plan.

segments.src: ## What to check before year-end
segments.tr: ## Qué revisar antes de fin de año

segments.src: The new thresholds apply to the next tax year, but your current-year decisions still matter.
segments.tr: Los nuevos umbrales se aplican al próximo año fiscal, pero sus decisiones del año en curso siguen importando.

segments.src: A short checklist:
segments.tr: Una lista de verificación breve:

segments.src: 1. **Review your withholding.** Use the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator to see whether you are on track to owe or receive a refund, and update your Form W-4 if needed.
segments.tr: 1. **Revise sus retenciones.** Use el Estimador de Retenciones del IRS para ver si va camino de deber impuestos o de recibir un reembolso, y actualice su Formulario W-4 si es necesario.

segments.src: 2. **Maximize or adjust retirement contributions.** Employer plan deferrals generally must be made by December 31. IRA contributions can usually be made until the tax filing deadline.
segments.tr: 2. **Maximice o ajuste las aportaciones para la jubilación.** Las aportaciones diferidas al plan del empleador generalmente deben realizarse antes del 31 de diciembre. Las aportaciones a IRA suelen poder hacerse hasta la fecha límite de presentación de la declaración.

segments.src: 3. **Use flexible spending accounts.** Some FSA balances are subject to use-it-or-lose-it rules, so check your plan's deadline and any carryover allowance.
segments.tr: 3. **Use las cuentas de gastos flexibles.** Algunos saldos de FSA están sujetos a la regla de «úselo o piérdalo», así que revise la fecha límite de su plan y cualquier permiso de arrastre (carryover).

segments.src: 4. **Look at investment gains and losses.** Selling losing positions can offset gains. Consider the timing of any large sale.
segments.tr: 4. **Revise las ganancias y pérdidas de inversiones.** Vender posiciones con pérdidas puede compensar ganancias. Considere el momento de cualquier venta importante.

segments.src: 5. **Consider charitable giving.** If you itemize or use a donor-advised fund, year-end is a common time to plan donations.
segments.tr: 5. **Considere las donaciones benéficas.** Si desglosa deducciones o usa un fondo asesorado por donantes, el cierre de año es un momento habitual para planificar donaciones.

segments.src: 6. **Estimate next year's income.** If you expect a major change, such as a new job, retirement, or a sale of property, consider how the new brackets may affect you.
segments.tr: 6. **Estime los ingresos del próximo año.** Si prevé un cambio importante, como un nuevo empleo, la jubilación o la venta de una propiedad, considere cómo pueden afectarle los nuevos tramos.

segments.src: 7. **Update estimated payments.** Self-employed workers and others with income not subject to withholding should check whether their fourth-quarter payment is on track.
segments.tr: 7. **Actualice los pagos estimados.** Los trabajadores por cuenta propia y otras personas con ingresos no sujetos a retención deben comprobar si su pago del cuarto trimestre va según lo previsto.

segments.src: ## Keep it in perspective
segments.tr: ## Mantenga la perspectiva

segments.src: Inflation adjustments are not a tax cut or a tax increase.
segments.tr: Los ajustes por inflación no son una rebaja ni un aumento de impuestos.

segments.src: They are designed to keep the tax system neutral against rising prices.
segments.tr: Están diseñados para mantener el sistema tributario neutral frente al aumento de precios.

segments.src: Their practical effect is usually modest, but they matter most when you combine them with a clear view of your own income, deductions, and savings goals.
segments.tr: Su efecto práctico suele ser moderado, pero cobra más importancia cuando se combina con una visión clara de sus propios ingresos, deducciones y objetivos de ahorro.

segments.src: Because individual circumstances vary, consider speaking with a qualified tax professional before making major decisions.
segments.tr: Como las circunstancias individuales varían, considere hablar con un profesional de impuestos cualificado antes de tomar decisiones importantes.

ar.title: أرقام الضرائب لعام 2027: كيف تغيّر تعديلات التضخم ما تدين به

segments.src: Every autumn, the Internal Revenue Service publishes updated federal tax figures for the coming year.
segments.tr: كل خريف، تنشر مصلحة الضرائب الأمريكية (IRS) أرقامًا ضريبية فيدرالية محدَّثة للعام القادم.

segments.src: The announcement is routine, but it affects almost every household: the income thresholds for each tax bracket, the standard deduction, and the contribution limits for retirement accounts all shift.
segments.tr: هذا الإعلان روتيني، لكنه يؤثر في كل أسرة تقريبًا: فحدود الدخل لكل شريحة ضريبية، والخصم القياسي، وحدود المساهمة في الحسابات التقاعدية، كلها تتغير.

segments.src: This explainer covers how those inflation adjustments work, why they matter for your paycheck and retirement planning, and what to review before the year ends.
segments.tr: يشرح هذا المقال كيفية عمل تعديلات التضخم هذه، ولماذا تهم راتبك وتخطيطك للتقاعد، وما الذي يجب مراجعته قبل نهاية العام.

segments.src: *Note: The IRS typically releases the next year's figures in October or early November.
segments.tr: *ملاحظة: تنشر مصلحة الضرائب عادةً أرقام العام التالي في أكتوبر أو أوائل نوفمبر.

segments.src: At the time of writing, check IRS.gov for the official 2027 numbers.
segments.tr: وقت كتابة هذا المقال، راجع موقع IRS.gov للحصول على الأرقام الرسمية لعام 2027.

segments.src: The 2026 figures cited below are used as a reference point and should be verified against current IRS guidance.*
segments.tr: الأرقام الخاصة بعام 2026 المذكورة أدناه تُستخدم كنقطة مرجعية، ويجب التحقق منها مقابل التوجيهات الحالية لمصلحة الضرائب.*

segments.src: ## Why the IRS adjusts for inflation
segments.tr: ## لماذا تعدّل مصلحة الضرائب القيم وفق التضخم

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: يعتمد نظام الضرائب الأمريكي

segments.src: tax system uses a progressive structure: income is taxed in layers, and each layer has its own rate.
segments.tr: على هيكل تصاعدي: يُفرض الدخل ضريبةً على طبقات، ولكل طبقة سعرها الخاص.

segments.src: Without adjustments, rising prices and wages would slowly push taxpayers into higher brackets even when their purchasing power had not improved.
segments.tr: ومن دون تعديلات، فإن ارتفاع الأسعار والأجور سيدفع دافعي الضرائب ببطء إلى شرائح أعلى حتى عندما لا تتحسن قدرتهم الشرائية.

segments.src: This effect is commonly called "bracket creep."
segments.tr: ويُعرف هذا الأثر عادةً باسم "انزلاق الشرائح" (bracket creep).

segments.src: To prevent it, federal law requires many tax parameters to be indexed to inflation each year.
segments.tr: ولمنع ذلك، يقتضي القانون الفيدرالي ربط كثير من المعايير الضريبية بمعدل التضخم كل عام.

segments.src: The IRS uses a price index, the chained Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (C-CPI-U), to calculate the changes.
segments.tr: تستخدم مصلحة الضرائب مؤشر أسعار، هو مؤشر أسعار المستهلكين المتسلسل لجميع المستهلكين في المناطق الحضرية (C-CPI-U)، لحساب التغييرات.

segments.src: The result is that thresholds generally move up in line with measured price growth, which helps keep your tax burden tied to real income rather than nominal income.
segments.tr: والنتيجة أن الحدود تتحرك عادةً تماشيًا مع نمو الأسعار المقاس، مما يساعد على إبقاء عبئك الضريبي مرتبطًا بالدخل الحقيقي لا بالدخل الاسمي.

segments.src: ## What gets adjusted
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يتم تعديله

segments.src: The annual update covers a long list of items.
segments.tr: يشمل التحديث السنوي قائمة طويلة من البنود.

segments.src: The ones most households notice include:
segments.tr: أبرز ما يلاحظه معظم الأسر:

segments.src: - **Tax bracket thresholds.** The income ranges for each marginal rate (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35% and 37%) move up. The rates themselves do not change through this process.
segments.tr: - **حدود الشرائح الضريبية.** تتحرك نطاقات الدخل لكل معدل حدّي (10% و12% و22% و24% و32% و35% و37%) إلى الأعلى. ولا تتغير المعدلات نفسها بهذه العملية.

segments.src: - **The standard deduction.** For tax year 2026, the IRS set it at $16,100 for single filers and $32,200 for married couples filing jointly. Expect a modest increase for 2027.
segments.tr: - **الخصم القياسي.** بالنسبة للسنة الضريبية 2026، حددته مصلحة الضرائب بمبلغ 16,100 دولار للأفراد غير المتزوجين و32,200 دولار للمتزوجين الذين يقدمون إقرارًا مشتركًا. ويُتوقع زيادة متواضعة في عام 2027.

segments.src: - **Retirement contribution limits.** For 2026, the 401(k) employee deferral limit is $24,500, with higher catch-up amounts for older workers. IRA limits are adjusted as well, though in increments that depend on rounding rules.
segments.tr: - **حدود المساهمة في التقاعد.** بالنسبة لعام 2026، حد الاستقطاع من راتب الموظف في خطة 401(k) هو 24,500 دولار، مع مبالغ تعويض أعلى للعمال الأكبر سنًا. وتُعدَّل حدود IRA كذلك، وإن كان ذلك بزيادات تعتمد على قواعد التقريب.

segments.src: - **Other items.** Income thresholds for certain credits, the Alternative Minimum Tax exemption, the annual gift tax exclusion, and flexible spending account limits are also indexed.
segments.tr: - **بنود أخرى.** كما تُربط بالتضخم حدود الدخل لبعض الائتمانات الضريبية، وإعفاء الحد الأدنى البديل للضريبة (AMT)، والاستثناء السنوي لضريبة الهدايا، وحدود حسابات الإنفاق المرن.

segments.src: ## A simple example of how brackets work
segments.tr: ## مثال مبسط على عمل الشرائح

segments.src: Brackets are marginal.
segments.tr: الشرائح حدّية.

segments.src: Moving into a higher bracket does not mean all of your income is taxed at the higher rate.
segments.tr: الانتقال إلى شريحة أعلى لا يعني أن كل دخلك يُفرض عليه المعدل الأعلى.

segments.src: Only the income above the threshold is taxed at that rate.
segments.tr: بل يُفرض هذا المعدل على الدخل الذي يتجاوز الحد فقط.

segments.src: Suppose a bracket begins at $50,000 this year and, after indexing, begins at $51,500 next year.
segments.tr: لنفترض أن شريحة تبدأ عند 50,000 دولار هذا العام، وبعد التعديل تبدأ عند 51,500 دولار في العام القادم.

segments.src: A taxpayer with $51,000 of taxable income would see part of that income taxed at the lower rate in the new year that was taxed at the higher rate before.
segments.tr: سيتعرض دافع ضرائب دخله الخاضع للضريبة 51,000 دولار لفرض المعدل الأدنى على جزء من دخله في العام الجديد، كان خاضعًا للمعدل الأعلى قبلًا.

segments.src: The effect on any one person is usually small, often tens or a few hundred dollars, but it adds up across a full year of paychecks.
segments.tr: وعادةً ما يكون الأثر على أي شخص بمفرده صغيرًا، غالبًا عشرات الدولارات أو بضع مئات، لكنه يتراكم على مدار عام كامل من الرواتب.

segments.src: ## What it means for your paycheck
segments.tr: ## ما معناه لراتبك

segments.src: Employers use IRS withholding tables to decide how much federal income tax to take from each paycheck.
segments.tr: يستخدم أصحاب العمل جداول الاستقطاع الضريبي من مصلحة الضرائب لتحديد مقدار ضريبة الدخل الفيدرالية التي تُقتطع من كل راتب.

segments.src: When the thresholds and standard deduction rise, those tables are updated, and your take-home pay may increase slightly, assuming your salary stays the same.
segments.tr: وعندما ترتفع الحدود والخصم القياسي، تُحدَّث تلك الجداول، وقد يزيد صافي راتبك قليلًا، بافتراض بقاء راتبك ثابتًا.

segments.src: If you receive a raise that outpaces inflation, however, more of your income can still land in higher brackets.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، إذا حصلت على زيادة تتجاوز التضخم، فقد يقع جزء أكبر من دخلك في شرائح أعلى.

segments.src: Indexing protects you from inflation alone, not from real income growth.
segments.tr: فالتعديل يحميك من التضخم وحده، لا من نمو الدخل الحقيقي.

segments.src: A year with a large raise, a bonus, a side business, or investment gains can still change your overall tax picture.
segments.tr: فالسنة التي تشهد زيادة كبيرة أو مكافأة أو عملًا جانبيًا أو أرباحًا استثمارية ما زالت قادرة على تغيير صورتك الضريبية الإجمالية.

segments.src: ## What it means for 401(k) and retirement planning
segments.tr: ## ما معناه للتخطيط لـ401(k) والتقاعد

segments.src: Higher contribution limits give savers more room to defer income.
segments.tr: ترفع حدود المساهمة الأعلى هامش الادخار أمام المدخرين لتأجيل جزء من دخلهم.

segments.src: Contributing more to a traditional 401(k) lowers your taxable income for the year, while Roth contributions do not give an upfront deduction but allow qualified withdrawals later without federal income tax.
segments.tr: فالمساهمة الأكبر في خطة 401(k) التقليدية تخفض دخلك الخاضع للضريبة في العام، بينما لا تمنح مساهمات Roth خصمًا فوريًا لكنها تسمح بسحوبات مؤهلة لاحقًا دون ضريبة دخل فيدرالية.

segments.src: A few points worth considering:
segments.tr: ثمة نقاط تستحق النظر فيها:

segments.src: - **Check your contribution percentage.** If your plan takes a percentage of pay, a raise or a higher limit may not change how much you actually save. If you want to use the full new limit, you may need to raise your election.
segments.tr: - **تحقق من نسبة مساهمتك.** إذا كانت خطتك تقتطع نسبة من الراتب، فقد لا تغيّر الزيادة أو الحد الأعلى مقدار ما تدخره فعليًا. وإذا أردت استخدام الحد الجديد كاملًا، فقد تحتاج إلى رفع اختيارك.

segments.src: - **Know the catch-up rules.** Workers age 50 and older can contribute extra amounts, and recent rules provide an even larger catch-up for certain ages. Some higher earners may be required to make catch-up contributions as Roth. Ask your plan administrator how it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **اعرف قواعد التعويض.** يمكن للعمال من سن 50 فما فوق المساهمة بمبالغ إضافية، وتتيح القواعد الحديثة تعويضًا أكبر لأعمار معينة. وقد يُطلب من بعض أصحاب الدخل المرتفع إجراء مساهمات التعويض بصيغة Roth. اسأل مدير خطتك عن كيفية تطبيق ذلك عليك.

segments.src: - **Confirm your employer match.** Make sure you are contributing enough to receive the full match your employer offers, since that is typically the most valuable benefit in the plan.
segments.tr: - **تأكد من مطابقة صاحب العمل.** تأكد من أنك تساهم بما يكفي للحصول على المطابقة الكاملة التي يقدمها صاحب العمل، فهي عادةً أثمن ميزة في الخطة.

segments.src: ## What to check before year-end
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراجعته قبل نهاية العام

segments.src: The new thresholds apply to the next tax year, but your current-year decisions still matter.
segments.tr: تنطبق الحدود الجديدة على السنة الضريبية القادمة، لكن قرارات السنة الحالية ما زالت مهمة.

segments.src: A short checklist:
segments.tr: قائمة مختصرة:

segments.src: 1. **Review your withholding.** Use the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator to see whether you are on track to owe or receive a refund, and update your Form W-4 if needed.
segments.tr: 1. **راجع الاستقطاع من راتبك.** استخدم أداة IRS Tax Withholding Estimator لمعرفة ما إذا كنت على المسار الصحيح لتدفع ضريبة إضافية أو تحصل على استرداد، وحدِّث نموذج W-4 عند الحاجة.

segments.src: 2. **Maximize or adjust retirement contributions.** Employer plan deferrals generally must be made by December 31. IRA contributions can usually be made until the tax filing deadline.
segments.tr: 2. **زد مساهماتك التقاعدية أو عدّلها.** يجب عادةً إجراء تأجيلات خطط صاحب العمل بحلول 31 ديسمبر. ويمكن عادةً إجراء مساهمات IRA حتى موعد تقديم الإقرار الضريبي.

segments.src: 3. **Use flexible spending accounts.** Some FSA balances are subject to use-it-or-lose-it rules, so check your plan's deadline and any carryover allowance.
segments.tr: 3. **استخدم حسابات الإنفاق المرن.** بعض أرصدة FSA تخضع لقاعدة "استخدمه أو تخسره"، لذا تحقق من الموعد النهائي لخطتك وأي سماح بترحيل الرصيد.

segments.src: 4. **Look at investment gains and losses.** Selling losing positions can offset gains. Consider the timing of any large sale.
segments.tr: 4. **انظر في أرباح الاستثمار وخسائره.** بيع المراكز الخاسرة يمكن أن يعوض المكاسب. فكّر في توقيت أي بيع كبير.

segments.src: 5. **Consider charitable giving.** If you itemize or use a donor-advised fund, year-end is a common time to plan donations.
segments.tr: 5. **فكّر في التبرعات الخيرية.** إذا كنت تُفصّل الخصومات أو تستخدم صندوق متبرع موجَّه (donor-advised fund)، فنهاية العام وقت شائع للتخطيط للتبرعات.

segments.src: 6. **Estimate next year's income.** If you expect a major change, such as a new job, retirement, or a sale of property, consider how the new brackets may affect you.
segments.tr: 6. **قدّر دخل العام القادم.** إذا كنت تتوقع تغيرًا كبيرًا، كوظيفة جديدة أو تقاعد أو بيع عقار، ففكّر في كيفية تأثير الشرائح الجديدة عليك.

segments.src: 7. **Update estimated payments.** Self-employed workers and others with income not subject to withholding should check whether their fourth-quarter payment is on track.
segments.tr: 7. **حدِّث الدفعات التقديرية.** ينبغي للعاملين لحسابهم الخاص وغيرهم ممن لديهم دخل لا يخضع للاستقطاع أن يتحققوا من أن دفعة الربع الرابع تسير على المسار الصحيح.

segments.src: ## Keep it in perspective
segments.tr: ## ضعه في سياقه

segments.src: Inflation adjustments are not a tax cut or a tax increase.
segments.tr: تعديلات التضخم ليست تخفيضًا ضريبيًا ولا زيادة ضريبية.

segments.src: They are designed to keep the tax system neutral against rising prices.
segments.tr: صُممت لإبقاء النظام الضريبي محايدًا أمام ارتفاع الأسعار.

segments.src: Their practical effect is usually modest, but they matter most when you combine them with a clear view of your own income, deductions, and savings goals.
segments.tr: وأثرها العملي عادةً متواضع، لكنه يكون الأهم عندما تجمعه برؤية واضحة لدخلك وخصوماتك وأهداف ادخارك.

segments.src: Because individual circumstances vary, consider speaking with a qualified tax professional before making major decisions.
segments.tr: ولأن الظروف الفردية تختلف، فكّر في استشارة متخصص ضرائبي مؤهل قبل اتخاذ قرارات كبيرة.

segments.src: For official figures and guidance, rely on IRS.gov and the IRS announcement of the 2027 inflation adjustments when it is published.
segments.tr: للأرقام والتوجيهات الرسمية، اعتمد على IRS.gov وإعلان مصلحة الضرائب بشأن تعديلات التضخم لعام 2027 عند نشره.

segments.src: ## Why the IRS adjusts for inflation
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi l'IRS ajuste en fonction de l'inflation

segments.src: The U.S.

segments.src: Without adjustments, rising prices and wages would slowly push taxpayers into higher brackets even when their purchasing power had not improved.

segments.src: This effect is commonly called "bracket creep."

segments.src: To prevent it, federal law requires many tax parameters to be indexed to inflation each year.

segments.src: ## What gets adjusted

segments.src: The annual update covers a long list of items.

segments.src: The ones most households notice include:
segments.tr: Ceux que la plupart des foyers remarquent sont les suivants :

segments.src: - **Tax bracket thresholds.** The income ranges for each marginal rate (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35% and 37%) move up. The rates themselves do not change through this process.
segments.tr: - **Seuils des tranches d'imposition.** Les fourchettes de revenu de chaque taux marginal (10 %, 12 %, 22 %, 24 %, 32 %, 35 % et 37 %) augmentent. Les taux eux-mêmes ne changent pas grâce à ce processus.

segments.src: - **The standard deduction.** For tax year 2026, the IRS set it at $16,100 for single filers and $32,200 for married couples filing jointly. Expect a modest increase for 2027.
segments.tr: - **La déduction forfaitaire.** Pour l'année fiscale 2026, l'IRS l'a fixée à 16 100 $ pour les célibataires et à 32 200 $ pour les couples mariés soumis à une déclaration commune. Attendez-vous à une hausse modeste pour 2027.

segments.src: - **Retirement contribution limits.** For 2026, the 401(k) employee deferral limit is $24,500, with higher catch-up amounts for older workers. IRA limits are adjusted as well, though in increments that depend on rounding rules.
segments.tr: - **Plafonds de cotisation à la retraite.** Pour 2026, le plafond de versement salarié au 401(k) est de 24 500 $, avec des montants de rattrapage plus élevés pour les travailleurs plus âgés. Les plafonds des IRA sont aussi ajustés, mais par paliers dépendant des règles d'arrondi.

segments.src: - **Other items.** Income thresholds for certain credits, the Alternative Minimum Tax exemption, the annual gift tax exclusion, and flexible spending account limits are also indexed.
segments.tr: - **Autres éléments.** Les seuils de revenu de certains crédits, l'exonération de l'impôt minimum de remplacement (AMT), l'exclusion annuelle pour donation et les plafonds des comptes d'épargne-santé flexibles (FSA) sont également indexés.

segments.src: ## A simple example of how brackets work
segments.tr: ## Un exemple simple du fonctionnement des tranches

segments.src: Brackets are marginal.
segments.tr: Les tranches sont marginales.

segments.src: Moving into a higher bracket does not mean all of your income is taxed at the higher rate.
segments.tr: Passer dans une tranche supérieure ne signifie pas que la totalité de votre revenu est imposée au taux plus élevé.

segments.src: Only the income above the threshold is taxed at that rate.
segments.tr: Seule la part du revenu au-delà du seuil est imposée à ce taux.

segments.src: Suppose a bracket begins at $50,000 this year and, after indexing, begins at $51,500 next year.
segments.tr: Supposons qu'une tranche commence à 50 000 $ cette année et, après indexation, à 51 500 $ l'année suivante.

segments.src: A taxpayer with $51,000 of taxable income would see part of that income taxed at the lower rate in the new year that was taxed at the higher rate before.
segments.tr: Un contribuable dont le revenu imposable est de 51 000 $ verrait une partie de ce revenu, qui était imposée au taux supérieur auparavant, imposée au taux inférieur l'année suivante.

segments.src: The effect on any one person is usually small, often tens or a few hundred dollars, but it adds up across a full year of paychecks.
segments.tr: L'effet sur une personne donnée est généralement faible, souvent de quelques dizaines ou de quelques centaines de dollars, mais il s'accumule sur une année entière de fiches de paie.

segments.src: ## What it means for your paycheck
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela change pour votre fiche de paie

segments.src: Employers use IRS withholding tables to decide how much federal income tax to take from each paycheck.
segments.tr: Les employeurs utilisent les barèmes de retenue à la source de l'IRS pour déterminer le montant de l'impôt fédéral sur le revenu prélevé sur chaque paie.

segments.src: When the thresholds and standard deduction rise, those tables are updated, and your take-home pay may increase slightly, assuming your salary stays the same.
segments.tr: Lorsque les seuils et la déduction forfaitaire augmentent, ces barèmes sont mis à jour, et votre salaire net peut légèrement augmenter, à salaire inchangé.

segments.src: If you receive a raise that outpaces inflation, however, more of your income can still land in higher brackets.
segments.tr: Si vous recevez toutefois une augmentation qui dépasse l'inflation, davantage de votre revenu peut tout de même tomber dans des tranches supérieures.

segments.src: Indexing protects you from inflation alone, not from real income growth.
segments.tr: L'indexation vous protège de la seule inflation, pas de la croissance du revenu réel.

segments.src: A year with a large raise, a bonus, a side business, or investment gains can still change your overall tax picture.
segments.tr: Une année avec une forte augmentation, une prime, une activité indépendante ou des gains de placement peut tout de même modifier l'ensemble de votre situation fiscale.

segments.src: ## What it means for 401(k) and retirement planning
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela change pour le 401(k) et la planification de la retraite

segments.src: Higher contribution limits give savers more room to defer income.
segments.tr: Des plafonds de cotisation plus élevés donnent aux épargnants plus de marge pour reporter leur revenu.

segments.src: Contributing more to a traditional 401(k) lowers your taxable income for the year, while Roth contributions do not give an upfront deduction but allow qualified withdrawals later without federal income tax.
segments.tr: Cotiser davantage dans un 401(k) traditionnel réduit votre revenu imposable pour l'année, tandis que les cotisations Roth n'ouvrent pas droit à une déduction immédiate, mais permettent des retraits qualifiés ultérieurs sans impôt fédéral sur le revenu.

segments.src: A few points worth considering:
segments.tr: Quelques points méritent réflexion :

segments.src: - **Check your contribution percentage.** If your plan takes a percentage of pay, a raise or a higher limit may not change how much you actually save. If you want to use the full new limit, you may need to raise your election.
segments.tr: - **Vérifiez votre pourcentage de cotisation.** Si votre régime prélève un pourcentage du salaire, une augmentation ou un plafond plus élevé ne changera peut-être pas le montant réellement épargné. Si vous voulez utiliser le nouveau plafond complet, il faudra peut-être augmenter votre choix de cotisation.

segments.src: - **Know the catch-up rules.** Workers age 50 and older can contribute extra amounts, and recent rules provide an even larger catch-up for certain ages. Some higher earners may be required to make catch-up contributions as Roth. Ask your plan administrator how it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **Connaissez les règles de rattrapage.** Les travailleurs âgés de 50 ans et plus peuvent cotiser des montants supplémentaires, et des règles récentes prévoient un rattrapage encore plus important pour certaines tranches d'âge. Certains salariés aux revenus élevés peuvent être tenus de faire leurs cotisations de rattrapage en Roth. Demandez à l'administrateur de votre régime comment cela s'applique à votre cas.

segments.src: - **Confirm your employer match.** Make sure you are contributing enough to receive the full match your employer offers, since that is typically the most valuable benefit in the plan.
segments.tr: - **Vérifiez la contrepartie de votre employeur.** Assurez-vous de cotiser suffisamment pour recevoir la totalité de la contrepartie offerte par votre employeur, car c'est généralement l'avantage le plus précieux du régime.

segments.src: ## What to check before year-end
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut vérifier avant la fin de l'année

segments.src: The new thresholds apply to the next tax year, but your current-year decisions still matter.
segments.tr: Les nouveaux seuils s'appliquent à l'année fiscale suivante, mais vos décisions de l'année en cours comptent toujours.

segments.src: A short checklist:
segments.tr: Une courte liste de contrôle :

segments.src: 1. **Review your withholding.** Use the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator to see whether you are on track to owe or receive a refund, and update your Form W-4 if needed.
segments.tr: 1. **Revoyez votre retenue à la source.** Utilisez l'outil d'estimation de retenue à la source de l'IRS pour voir si vous êtes en voie de devoir un montant ou de recevoir un remboursement, et mettez à jour votre formulaire W-4 si nécessaire.

segments.src: 2. **Maximize or adjust retirement contributions.** Employer plan deferrals generally must be made by December 31. IRA contributions can usually be made until the tax filing deadline.
segments.tr: 2. **Maximisez ou ajustez vos cotisations de retraite.** Les versements aux régimes d'employeur doivent généralement être effectués avant le 31 décembre. Les cotisations IRA peuvent généralement être versées jusqu'à la date limite de dépôt de la déclaration.

segments.src: 3. **Use flexible spending accounts.** Some FSA balances are subject to use-it-or-lose-it rules, so check your plan's deadline and any carryover allowance.
segments.tr: 3. **Utilisez les comptes d'épargne-santé flexibles.** Certains soldes de FSA sont soumis à la règle du « utiliser ou perdre », vérifiez donc la date limite de votre régime et toute possibilité de report.

segments.src: 4. **Look at investment gains and losses.** Selling losing positions can offset gains. Consider the timing of any large sale.
segments.tr: 4. **Examinez les gains et pertes de placement.** Vendre des positions en perte peut compenser des gains. Réfléchissez au moment de toute vente importante.

segments.src: 5. **Consider charitable giving.** If you itemize or use a donor-advised fund, year-end is a common time to plan donations.
segments.tr: 5. **Envisagez les dons de bienfaisance.** Si vous détaillez vos déductions ou utilisez un fonds à conseil de donateur, la fin de l'année est un moment courant pour planifier vos dons.

segments.src: 6. **Estimate next year's income.** If you expect a major change, such as a new job, retirement, or a sale of property, consider how the new brackets may affect you.
segments.tr: 6. **Estimez le revenu de l'année suivante.** Si vous prévoyez un changement majeur, comme un nouvel emploi, une retraite ou la vente d'un bien, examinez comment les nouvelles tranches pourraient vous affecter.

segments.src: 7. **Update estimated payments.** Self-employed workers and others with income not subject to withholding should check whether their fourth-quarter payment is on track.
segments.tr: 7. **Mettez à jour vos acomptes.** Les travailleurs indépendants et ceux dont le revenu n'est pas soumis à retenue à la source doivent vérifier si leur paiement du quatrième trimestre est sur la bonne voie.

segments.src: ## Keep it in perspective
segments.tr: ## Garder les choses en perspective

segments.src: Inflation adjustments are not a tax cut or a tax increase.
segments.tr: Les ajustements liés à l'inflation ne sont ni une baisse ni une hausse d'impôt.

segments.src: They are designed to keep the tax system neutral against rising prices.
segments.tr: Ils visent à maintenir le système fiscal neutre face à la hausse des prix.

segments.src: Their practical effect is usually modest, but they matter most when you combine them with a clear view of your own income, deductions, and savings goals.
segments.tr: Leur effet pratique est généralement modeste, mais ils comptent le plus lorsqu'on les combine avec une vision claire de vos propres revenus, déductions et objectifs d'épargne.

segments.src: Because individual circumstances vary, consider speaking with a qualified tax professional before making major decisions.
segments.tr: Comme les situations individuelles varient, envisagez de consulter un professionnel de la fiscalité qualifié avant de prendre des décisions importantes.

segments.src: For official figures and guidance, rely on IRS.gov and the IRS announcement of the 2027 inflation adjustments when it is published.
segments.tr: Pour les chiffres et directives officiels, référez-vous à IRS.gov et à l'annonce de l'IRS sur les ajustements liés à l'inflation 2027 lorsqu'elle sera publiée.
