pt.title: Faixas de Imposto de 2027: Como os Ajustes pela Inflação Mudam o Que Você Deve

segments.src: Every autumn, the Internal Revenue Service publishes updated federal tax figures for the coming year.
segments.tr: Todo outono, o Internal Revenue Service (IRS) publica os valores federais atualizados de impostos para o ano seguinte.

segments.src: The announcement is routine, but it affects almost every household: the income thresholds for each tax bracket, the standard deduction, and the contribution limits for retirement accounts all shift.
segments.tr: O anúncio é rotineiro, mas afeta quase todas as famílias: os limites de renda de cada faixa de imposto, a dedução padrão e os limites de contribuição para contas de aposentadoria mudam.

segments.src: This explainer covers how those inflation adjustments work, why they matter for your paycheck and retirement planning, and what to review before the year ends.
segments.tr: Este texto explica como funcionam esses ajustes pela inflação, por que eles importam para o seu contracheque e para o planejamento de aposentadoria, e o que revisar antes do fim do ano.

segments.src: *Note: The IRS typically releases the next year's figures in October or early November.
segments.tr: *Nota: O IRS normalmente divulga os valores do ano seguinte em outubro ou no início de novembro.

segments.src: At the time of writing, check IRS.gov for the official 2027 numbers.
segments.tr: No momento em que este texto foi escrito, consulte o IRS.gov para os números oficiais de 2027.

segments.src: The 2026 figures cited below are used as a reference point and should be verified against current IRS guidance.*
segments.tr: Os valores de 2026 citados abaixo servem como referência e devem ser verificados com as orientações atuais do IRS.*

segments.src: ## Why the IRS adjusts for inflation
segments.tr: ## Por que o IRS ajusta pela inflação

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: O sistema tributário dos EUA

segments.src: tax system uses a progressive structure: income is taxed in layers, and each layer has its own rate.
segments.tr: é progressivo: a renda é tributada em camadas, e cada camada tem sua própria alíquota.

segments.src: Without adjustments, rising prices and wages would slowly push taxpayers into higher brackets even when their purchasing power had not improved.
segments.tr: Sem ajustes, a alta de preços e de salários empurraria lentamente os contribuintes para faixas mais altas, mesmo quando o poder de compra deles não tivesse melhorado.

segments.src: This effect is commonly called "bracket creep."
segments.tr: Esse efeito é comumente chamado de "bracket creep".

segments.src: To prevent it, federal law requires many tax parameters to be indexed to inflation each year.
segments.tr: Para evitar isso, a lei federal exige que muitos parâmetros tributários sejam indexados à inflação todo ano.

segments.src: The IRS uses a price index, the chained Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (C-CPI-U), to calculate the changes.
segments.tr: O IRS usa um índice de preços, o chained Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (C-CPI-U), para calcular as mudanças.

segments.src: The result is that thresholds generally move up in line with measured price growth, which helps keep your tax burden tied to real income rather than nominal income.
segments.tr: O resultado é que os limites geralmente sobem acompanhando o crescimento medido dos preços, o que ajuda a manter sua carga tributária ligada à renda real, e não à renda nominal.

segments.src: ## What gets adjusted
segments.tr: ## O que é ajustado

segments.src: The annual update covers a long list of items.
segments.tr: A atualização anual abrange uma longa lista de itens.

segments.src: The ones most households notice include:
segments.tr: Os que a maioria das famílias percebe incluem:

segments.src: - **Tax bracket thresholds.** The income ranges for each marginal rate (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35% and 37%) move up. The rates themselves do not change through this process.
segments.tr: - **Limites das faixas de imposto.** As faixas de renda de cada alíquota marginal (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35% e 37%) sobem. As alíquotas em si não mudam com esse processo.

segments.src: - **The standard deduction.** For tax year 2026, the IRS set it at $16,100 for single filers and $32,200 for married couples filing jointly. Expect a modest increase for 2027.
segments.tr: - **A dedução padrão.** Para o ano-base de 2026, o IRS fixou o valor em US$ 16.100 para contribuintes solteiros e US$ 32.200 para casais que declaram conjuntamente. Espera-se um aumento modesto para 2027.

segments.src: - **Retirement contribution limits.** For 2026, the 401(k) employee deferral limit is $24,500, with higher catch-up amounts for older workers. IRA limits are adjusted as well, though in increments that depend on rounding rules.
segments.tr: - **Limites de contribuição para aposentadoria.** Para 2026, o limite de contribuição do funcionário para o 401(k) é de US$ 24.500, com valores extras de recuperação (catch-up) para trabalhadores mais velhos. Os limites do IRA também são ajustados, porém em incrementos que dependem das regras de arredondamento.

segments.src: - **Other items.** Income thresholds for certain credits, the Alternative Minimum Tax exemption, the annual gift tax exclusion, and flexible spending account limits are also indexed.
segments.tr: - **Outros itens.** Os limites de renda para certos créditos, a isenção do Imposto Mínimo Alternativo (AMT), a exclusão anual do imposto sobre doações e os limites das contas de gastos flexíveis (FSA) também são indexados.

segments.src: ## A simple example of how brackets work
segments.tr: ## Um exemplo simples de como as faixas funcionam

segments.src: Brackets are marginal.
segments.tr: As faixas são marginais.

segments.src: Moving into a higher bracket does not mean all of your income is taxed at the higher rate.
segments.tr: Passar para uma faixa mais alta não significa que toda a sua renda seja tributada na alíquota maior.

segments.src: Only the income above the threshold is taxed at that rate.
segments.tr: Só a parcela da renda acima do limite é tributada nessa alíquota.

segments.src: Suppose a bracket begins at $50,000 this year and, after indexing, begins at $51,500 next year.
segments.tr: Suponha que uma faixa comece em US$ 50.000 este ano e, após a indexação, comece em US$ 51.500 no ano seguinte.

segments.src: A taxpayer with $51,000 of taxable income would see part of that income taxed at the lower rate in the new year that was taxed at the higher rate before.
segments.tr: Um contribuinte com US$ 51.000 de renda tributável teria parte dessa renda tributada na alíquota menor no novo ano, quando antes era tributada na alíquota maior.

segments.src: The effect on any one person is usually small, often tens or a few hundred dollars, but it adds up across a full year of paychecks.
segments.tr: O efeito sobre cada pessoa costuma ser pequeno, muitas vezes de dezenas ou de algumas centenas de dólares, mas se acumula ao longo de um ano inteiro de contracheques.

segments.src: ## What it means for your paycheck
segments.tr: ## O que isso significa para o seu contracheque

segments.src: Employers use IRS withholding tables to decide how much federal income tax to take from each paycheck.
segments.tr: Os empregadores usam as tabelas de retenção do IRS para decidir quanto imposto federal de renda descontar de cada contracheque.

segments.src: When the thresholds and standard deduction rise, those tables are updated, and your take-home pay may increase slightly, assuming your salary stays the same.
segments.tr: Quando os limites e a dedução padrão sobem, essas tabelas são atualizadas, e o seu salário líquido pode aumentar um pouco, desde que o salário bruto permaneça o mesmo.

segments.src: If you receive a raise that outpaces inflation, however, more of your income can still land in higher brackets.
segments.tr: Se você receber um aumento acima da inflação, porém, ainda assim parte maior da sua renda pode cair em faixas mais altas.

segments.src: Indexing protects you from inflation alone, not from real income growth.
segments.tr: A indexação protege você apenas da inflação, não do crescimento da renda real.

segments.src: A year with a large raise, a bonus, a side business, or investment gains can still change your overall tax picture.
segments.tr: Um ano com um aumento grande, um bônus, um negócio paralelo ou ganhos de investimento ainda pode mudar o seu quadro tributário geral.

segments.src: ## What it means for 401(k) and retirement planning
segments.tr: ## O que isso significa para o 401(k) e o planejamento de aposentadoria

segments.src: Higher contribution limits give savers more room to defer income.
segments.tr: Limites de contribuição mais altos dão aos poupadores mais espaço para adiar renda.

segments.src: Contributing more to a traditional 401(k) lowers your taxable income for the year, while Roth contributions do not give an upfront deduction but allow qualified withdrawals later without federal income tax.
segments.tr: Contribuir mais para um 401(k) tradicional reduz sua renda tributável no ano, enquanto contribuições para um Roth não dão dedução imediata, mas permitem saques qualificados no futuro sem imposto federal de renda.

segments.src: A few points worth considering:
segments.tr: Alguns pontos merecem atenção:

segments.src: - **Check your contribution percentage.** If your plan takes a percentage of pay, a raise or a higher limit may not change how much you actually save. If you want to use the full new limit, you may need to raise your election.
segments.tr: - **Verifique seu percentual de contribuição.** Se o seu plano desconta um percentual do salário, um aumento ou um limite maior pode não mudar quanto você realmente poupa. Se quiser usar o novo limite integral, talvez seja preciso aumentar sua escolha.

segments.src: - **Know the catch-up rules.** Workers age 50 and older can contribute extra amounts, and recent rules provide an even larger catch-up for certain ages. Some higher earners may be required to make catch-up contributions as Roth. Ask your plan administrator how it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **Conheça as regras de recuperação (catch-up).** Trabalhadores com 50 anos ou mais podem contribuir com valores extras, e regras recentes prevêem uma recuperação ainda maior para certas faixas etárias. Alguns contribuintes de alta renda podem ser obrigados a fazer contribuições de recuperação no formato Roth. Pergunte ao administrador do seu plano como isso se aplica a você.

segments.src: - **Confirm your employer match.** Make sure you are contributing enough to receive the full match your employer offers, since that is typically the most valuable benefit in the plan.
segments.tr: - **Confirme a contrapartida do empregador.** Certifique-se de estar contribuindo o suficiente para receber a contrapartida integral oferecida pelo empregador, já que ela costuma ser o benefício mais valioso do plano.

segments.src: ## What to check before year-end
segments.tr: ## O que verificar antes do fim do ano

segments.src: The new thresholds apply to the next tax year, but your current-year decisions still matter.
segments.tr: As novas faixas se aplicam ao próximo ano-base, mas as decisões do ano corrente continuam importando.

segments.src: A short checklist:
segments.tr: Uma lista de verificação rápida:

segments.src: 1. **Review your withholding.** Use the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator to see whether you are on track to owe or receive a refund, and update your Form W-4 if needed.
segments.tr: 1. **Revise sua retenção.** Use o IRS Tax Withholding Estimator para ver se você caminha para pagar imposto ou receber restituição, e atualize seu Formulário W-4, se necessário.

segments.src: 2. **Maximize or adjust retirement contributions.** Employer plan deferrals generally must be made by December 31. IRA contributions can usually be made until the tax filing deadline.
segments.tr: 2. **Maximize ou ajuste as contribuições para aposentadoria.** As contribuições ao plano do empregador geralmente precisam ser feitas até 31 de dezembro. Contribuições para IRA normalmente podem ser feitas até o prazo de entrega da declaração.

segments.src: 3. **Use flexible spending accounts.** Some FSA balances are subject to use-it-or-lose-it rules, so check your plan's deadline and any carryover allowance.
segments.tr: 3. **Use contas de gastos flexíveis.** Alguns saldos de FSA estão sujeitos à regra de uso-ou-perde, então verifique o prazo do seu plano e qualquer permissão de transferência de saldo.

segments.src: 4. **Look at investment gains and losses.** Selling losing positions can offset gains. Consider the timing of any large sale.
segments.tr: 4. **Analise ganhos e perdas de investimentos.** Vender posições com prejuízo pode compensar ganhos. Considere o momento de qualquer venda de grande valor.

segments.src: 5. **Consider charitable giving.** If you itemize or use a donor-advised fund, year-end is a common time to plan donations.
segments.tr: 5. **Considere doações de caridade.** Se você declara despesas detalhadamente (itemize) ou usa um fundo consultivo de doadores (donor-advised fund), o fim do ano é um momento comum para planejar doações.

segments.src: 6. **Estimate next year's income.** If you expect a major change, such as a new job, retirement, or a sale of property, consider how the new brackets may affect you.
segments.tr: 6. **Estime a renda do próximo ano.** Se você espera uma mudança grande, como um novo emprego, aposentadoria ou venda de imóvel, considere como as novas faixas podem afetar você.

segments.src: 7. **Update estimated payments.** Self-employed workers and others with income not subject to withholding should check whether their fourth-quarter payment is on track.
segments.tr: 7. **Atualize os pagamentos estimados.** Autônomos e outras pessoas com renda sem retenção devem verificar se o pagamento do quarto trimestre está em dia.

segments.tr: ## Mantenha em perspectiva

segments.tr: Setiap musim gugur, Internal Revenue Service (IRS) menerbitkan angka pajak federal yang diperbarui untuk tahun berikutnya.

segments.src: The announcement is routine, but it affects almost every household: the income thresholds for each tax bracket, the standard deduction, and the contribution limits for retirement accounts all shift.
segments.tr: Pengumuman ini bersifat rutin, tetapi berdampak pada hampir setiap rumah tangga: ambang pendapatan untuk setiap kelompok tarif pajak, pengurangan standar, dan batas kontribusi untuk rekening pensiun ikut berubah.

segments.src: This explainer covers how those inflation adjustments work, why they matter for your paycheck and retirement planning, and what to review before the year ends.
segments.tr: Penjelasan ini membahas cara kerja penyesuaian inflasi tersebut, mengapa hal itu penting bagi gaji bulanan dan perencanaan pensiun Anda, serta hal apa saja yang perlu ditinjau sebelum akhir tahun.

segments.src: *Note: The IRS typically releases the next year's figures in October or early November.
segments.tr: *Catatan: IRS biasanya merilis angka tahun berikutnya pada Oktober atau awal November.

segments.src: At the time of writing, check IRS.gov for the official 2027 numbers.
segments.tr: Pada saat tulisan ini dibuat, periksa IRS.gov untuk angka resmi 2027.

segments.src: The 2026 figures cited below are used as a reference point and should be verified against current IRS guidance.*
segments.tr: Angka 2026 yang disebutkan di bawah digunakan sebagai titik acuan dan harus diverifikasi terhadap panduan IRS terkini.*

segments.src: ## Why the IRS adjusts for inflation
segments.tr: ## Mengapa IRS melakukan penyesuaian inflasi

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Sistem pajak A.S.

segments.src: tax system uses a progressive structure: income is taxed in layers, and each layer has its own rate.
segments.tr: menggunakan struktur progresif: penghasilan dikenai pajak dalam beberapa lapisan, dan setiap lapisan memiliki tarifnya sendiri.

segments.src: Without adjustments, rising prices and wages would slowly push taxpayers into higher brackets even when their purchasing power had not improved.
segments.tr: Tanpa penyesuaian, kenaikan harga dan upah secara perlahan akan mendorong wajib pajak ke kelompok tarif yang lebih tinggi meskipun daya beli mereka tidak membaik.

segments.src: This effect is commonly called "bracket creep."
segments.tr: Efek ini biasa disebut "bracket creep" (perayapan kelompok tarif).

segments.src: To prevent it, federal law requires many tax parameters to be indexed to inflation each year.
segments.tr: Untuk mencegahnya, hukum federal mewajibkan banyak parameter pajak diindeks terhadap inflasi setiap tahun.

segments.src: The IRS uses a price index, the chained Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (C-CPI-U), to calculate the changes.
segments.tr: IRS menggunakan indeks harga, yaitu chained Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (C-CPI-U), untuk menghitung perubahannya.

segments.src: The result is that thresholds generally move up in line with measured price growth, which helps keep your tax burden tied to real income rather than nominal income.
segments.tr: Hasilnya, ambang batas umumnya naik sejalan dengan pertumbuhan harga yang terukur, sehingga beban pajak Anda tetap terkait dengan pendapatan riil, bukan pendapatan nominal.

segments.src: ## What gets adjusted
segments.tr: ## Apa saja yang disesuaikan

segments.src: The annual update covers a long list of items.
segments.tr: Pembaruan tahunan mencakup daftar item yang panjang.

segments.src: The ones most households notice include:
segments.tr: Item yang paling dirasakan sebagian besar rumah tangga meliputi:

segments.src: - **Tax bracket thresholds.** The income ranges for each marginal rate (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35% and 37%) move up. The rates themselves do not change through this process.
segments.tr: - **Ambang kelompok tarif pajak.** Rentang pendapatan untuk setiap tarif marginal (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35% dan 37%) naik. Tarifnya sendiri tidak berubah melalui proses ini.

segments.src: - **The standard deduction.** For tax year 2026, the IRS set it at $16,100 for single filers and $32,200 for married couples filing jointly. Expect a modest increase for 2027.
segments.tr: - **Pengurangan standar.** Untuk tahun pajak 2026, IRS menetapkannya sebesar $16.100 untuk wajib pajak tunggal dan $32.200 untuk pasangan yang mengajukan SPT bersama. Diperkirakan naik sedikit pada 2027.

segments.src: - **Retirement contribution limits.** For 2026, the 401(k) employee deferral limit is $24,500, with higher catch-up amounts for older workers. IRA limits are adjusted as well, though in increments that depend on rounding rules.
segments.tr: - **Batas kontribusi pensiun.** Untuk 2026, batas setoran karyawan 401(k) adalah $24.500, dengan jumlah catch-up yang lebih tinggi bagi pekerja yang lebih tua. Batas IRA juga disesuaikan, meskipun dalam kelipatan yang bergantung pada aturan pembulatan.

segments.src: - **Other items.** Income thresholds for certain credits, the Alternative Minimum Tax exemption, the annual gift tax exclusion, and flexible spending account limits are also indexed.
segments.tr: - **Item lainnya.** Ambang pendapatan untuk kredit tertentu, batas Alternative Minimum Tax, pengecualian pajak hadiah tahunan, dan batas flexible spending account juga diindeks.

segments.src: ## A simple example of how brackets work
segments.tr: ## Contoh sederhana cara kerja kelompok tarif

segments.src: Brackets are marginal.
segments.tr: Kelompok tarif bersifat marginal.

segments.src: Moving into a higher bracket does not mean all of your income is taxed at the higher rate.
segments.tr: Pindah ke kelompok tarif yang lebih tinggi tidak berarti seluruh penghasilan Anda dikenai tarif yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: Only the income above the threshold is taxed at that rate.
segments.tr: Hanya penghasilan di atas ambang batas yang dikenai tarif tersebut.

segments.src: Suppose a bracket begins at $50,000 this year and, after indexing, begins at $51,500 next year.
segments.tr: Misalkan suatu kelompok tarif dimulai dari $50.000 tahun ini dan, setelah diindeks, dimulai dari $51.500 tahun depan.

segments.src: A taxpayer with $51,000 of taxable income would see part of that income taxed at the lower rate in the new year that was taxed at the higher rate before.
segments.tr: Wajib pajak dengan penghasilan kena pajak $51.000 akan melihat sebagian penghasilannya, yang sebelumnya dikenai tarif lebih tinggi, dikenai tarif yang lebih rendah pada tahun baru.

segments.src: The effect on any one person is usually small, often tens or a few hundred dollars, but it adds up across a full year of paychecks.
segments.tr: Dampaknya bagi setiap orang biasanya kecil, sering kali puluhan atau beberapa ratus dolar, tetapi jumlahnya bertambah sepanjang tahun dari setiap gaji.

segments.src: ## What it means for your paycheck
segments.tr: ## Dampaknya terhadap gaji Anda

segments.src: Employers use IRS withholding tables to decide how much federal income tax to take from each paycheck.
segments.tr: Pemberi kerja menggunakan tabel pemotongan (withholding) IRS untuk menentukan berapa pajak penghasilan federal yang dipotong dari setiap gaji.

segments.src: When the thresholds and standard deduction rise, those tables are updated, and your take-home pay may increase slightly, assuming your salary stays the same.
segments.tr: Ketika ambang batas dan pengurangan standar naik, tabel tersebut diperbarui, dan gaji bersih Anda mungkin naik sedikit, dengan asumsi gaji pokok Anda tetap.

segments.src: If you receive a raise that outpaces inflation, however, more of your income can still land in higher brackets.
segments.tr: Namun, jika Anda menerima kenaikan gaji yang melampaui inflasi, lebih banyak penghasilan Anda tetap bisa masuk ke kelompok tarif yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: Indexing protects you from inflation alone, not from real income growth.
segments.tr: Pengindeksan melindungi Anda dari inflasi saja, bukan dari pertumbuhan pendapatan riil.

segments.src: A year with a large raise, a bonus, a side business, or investment gains can still change your overall tax picture.
segments.tr: Tahun dengan kenaikan gaji besar, bonus, usaha sampingan, atau keuntungan investasi tetap dapat mengubah gambaran pajak keseluruhan Anda.

segments.src: ## What it means for 401(k) and retirement planning
segments.tr: ## Dampaknya terhadap 401(k) dan perencanaan pensiun

segments.src: Higher contribution limits give savers more room to defer income.
segments.tr: Batas kontribusi yang lebih tinggi memberi penabung lebih banyak ruang untuk menunda penghasilan.

segments.src: Contributing more to a traditional 401(k) lowers your taxable income for the year, while Roth contributions do not give an upfront deduction but allow qualified withdrawals later without federal income tax.
segments.tr: Menyetor lebih banyak ke 401(k) tradisional menurunkan penghasilan kena pajak Anda untuk tahun tersebut, sedangkan kontribusi Roth tidak memberikan pengurangan di awal, tetapi memungkinkan penarikan yang memenuhi syarat di kemudian hari tanpa pajak penghasilan federal.

segments.src: A few points worth considering:
segments.tr: Beberapa poin yang layak dipertimbangkan:

segments.src: - **Check your contribution percentage.** If your plan takes a percentage of pay, a raise or a higher limit may not change how much you actually save. If you want to use the full new limit, you may need to raise your election.
segments.tr: - **Periksa persentase kontribusi Anda.** Jika rencana Anda memotong persentase dari gaji, kenaikan gaji atau batas yang lebih tinggi mungkin tidak mengubah jumlah yang benar-benar Anda tabung. Jika ingin memanfaatkan batas baru sepenuhnya, Anda mungkin perlu menaikkan pilihan setoran Anda.

segments.src: - **Know the catch-up rules.** Workers age 50 and older can contribute extra amounts, and recent rules provide an even larger catch-up for certain ages. Some higher earners may be required to make catch-up contributions as Roth. Ask your plan administrator how it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **Pahami aturan catch-up.** Pekerja berusia 50 tahun ke atas dapat menyetor jumlah tambahan, dan aturan terbaru memberikan catch-up yang lebih besar untuk usia tertentu. Sebagian berpenghasilan tinggi mungkin diwajibkan menyetor catch-up sebagai Roth. Tanyakan kepada administrator rencana Anda bagaimana aturan ini berlaku untuk Anda.

segments.src: - **Confirm your employer match.** Make sure you are contributing enough to receive the full match your employer offers, since that is typically the most valuable benefit in the plan.
segments.tr: - **Pastikan kecocokan (match) dari pemberi kerja.** Pastikan Anda menyetor cukup untuk menerima seluruh kecocokan yang ditawarkan pemberi kerja, karena itu biasanya manfaat paling berharga dalam rencana tersebut.

segments.src: ## What to check before year-end
segments.tr: ## Yang perlu diperiksa sebelum akhir tahun

segments.src: The new thresholds apply to the next tax year, but your current-year decisions still matter.
segments.tr: Ambang batas baru berlaku untuk tahun pajak berikutnya, tetapi keputusan Anda di tahun berjalan tetap penting.

segments.src: A short checklist:
segments.tr: Daftar periksa singkat:

segments.src: 1. **Review your withholding.** Use the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator to see whether you are on track to owe or receive a refund, and update your Form W-4 if needed.
segments.tr: 1. **Tinjau pemotongan pajak Anda.** Gunakan IRS Tax Withholding Estimator untuk melihat apakah Anda berada di jalur untuk membayar kekurangan atau menerima pengembalian, dan perbarui Formulir W-4 jika diperlukan.

segments.src: 2. **Maximize or adjust retirement contributions.** Employer plan deferrals generally must be made by December 31. IRA contributions can usually be made until the tax filing deadline.
segments.tr: 2. **Maksimalkan atau sesuaikan kontribusi pensiun.** Setoran rencana pemberi kerja umumnya harus dilakukan paling lambat 31 Desember. Kontribusi IRA biasanya dapat dilakukan hingga batas waktu pengajuan pajak.

segments.src: 3. **Use flexible spending accounts.** Some FSA balances are subject to use-it-or-lose-it rules, so check your plan's deadline and any carryover allowance.
segments.tr: 3. **Gunakan flexible spending account.** Saldo FSA tertentu tunduk pada aturan "pakai atau hangus", jadi periksa batas waktu rencana Anda dan batasan carryover yang berlaku.

segments.src: 4. **Look at investment gains and losses.** Selling losing positions can offset gains. Consider the timing of any large sale.
segments.tr: 4. **Perhatikan keuntungan dan kerugian investasi.** Menjual posisi yang merugi dapat mengimbangi keuntungan. Pertimbangkan waktu penjualan besar apa pun.

segments.src: 5. **Consider charitable giving.** If you itemize or use a donor-advised fund, year-end is a common time to plan donations.
segments.tr: 5. **Pertimbangkan donasi amal.** Jika Anda memakai itemized deduction atau donor-advised fund, akhir tahun adalah waktu yang umum untuk merencanakan donasi.

segments.src: 6. **Estimate next year's income.** If you expect a major change, such as a new job, retirement, or a sale of property, consider how the new brackets may affect you.
segments.tr: 6. **Perkirakan penghasilan tahun depan.** Jika Anda memperkirakan perubahan besar, seperti pekerjaan baru, pensiun, atau penjualan properti, pertimbangkan bagaimana kelompok tarif baru dapat memengaruhi Anda.

segments.src: 7. **Update estimated payments.** Self-employed workers and others with income not subject to withholding should check whether their fourth-quarter payment is on track.
segments.tr: 7. **Perbarui pembayaran estimasi.** Pekerja lepas dan orang lain dengan penghasilan yang tidak dipotong pajak sebaiknya memeriksa apakah pembayaran kuartal keempat mereka sudah sesuai jalurnya.

segments.src: ## Keep it in perspective
segments.tr: ## Tetap melihat gambaran besar

segments.src: Inflation adjustments are not a tax cut or a tax increase.
segments.tr: Penyesuaian inflasi bukan pemotongan pajak atau kenaikan pajak.

segments.src: They are designed to keep the tax system neutral against rising prices.
segments.tr: Penyesuaian ini dirancang untuk menjaga sistem pajak tetap netral terhadap kenaikan harga.

segments.src: Their practical effect is usually modest, but they matter most when you combine them with a clear view of your own income, deductions, and savings goals.
segments.tr: Dampak praktisnya biasanya sederhana, tetapi paling terasa ketika digabungkan dengan pemahaman yang jelas tentang penghasilan, pengurangan, dan tujuan tabungan Anda.

segments.src: Because individual circumstances vary, consider speaking with a qualified tax professional before making major decisions.
segments.tr: Karena keadaan setiap orang berbeda, pertimbangkan untuk berkonsultasi dengan konsultan pajak yang berkualifikasi sebelum mengambil keputusan besar.

segments.src: For official figures and guidance, rely on IRS.gov and the IRS announcement of the 2027 inflation adjustments when it is published.
segments.tr: Untuk angka dan panduan resmi, andalkan IRS.gov dan pengumuman IRS tentang penyesuaian inflasi 2027 saat dipublikasikan.

segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk tujuan informasi umum dan bukan nasihat pajak, hukum, atau keuangan.*

ja.title: 2027年の税率区分：インフレ調整で税負担はどう変わるか

segments.src: Every autumn, the Internal Revenue Service publishes updated federal tax figures for the coming year.
segments.tr: 毎年秋、米国内国歳入庁（IRS）は翌年の連邦税に関する最新の数値を公表します。

segments.src: The announcement is routine, but it affects almost every household: the income thresholds for each tax bracket, the standard deduction, and the contribution limits for retirement accounts all shift.
segments.tr: この発表は定例のものですが、ほぼすべての世帯に影響します。各税率区分の所得基準、標準控除、退職金口座の拠出上限はすべて変動するからです。

segments.src: This explainer covers how those inflation adjustments work, why they matter for your paycheck and retirement planning, and what to review before the year ends.
segments.tr: この解説では、これらのインフレ調整の仕組み、給与と退職計画にとっての重要性、そして年末前に確認すべき点を扱います。

segments.src: *Note: The IRS typically releases the next year's figures in October or early November.
segments.tr: *注：IRSは通常、翌年の数値を10月または11月上旬に公表します。

segments.src: At the time of writing, check IRS.gov for the official 2027 numbers.
segments.tr: 執筆時点では、2027年の正式な数値はIRS.govで確認してください。

segments.src: The 2026 figures cited below are used as a reference point and should be verified against current IRS guidance.*
segments.tr: 以下で示す2026年の数値は参考基準として用いたものであり、最新のIRS指針で照合する必要があります。*

segments.src: ## Why the IRS adjusts for inflation
segments.tr: ## IRSがインフレ調整を行う理由

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 米国の

segments.src: tax system uses a progressive structure: income is taxed in layers, and each layer has its own rate.
segments.tr: 税制は累進構造を採用しています。所得は層に分けて課税され、各層には個別の税率が適用されます。

segments.src: Without adjustments, rising prices and wages would slowly push taxpayers into higher brackets even when their purchasing power had not improved.
segments.tr: 調整がなければ、物価と賃金の上昇によって、実質的な購買力が向上していなくても納税者は徐々により高い税率区分に押し上げられてしまいます。

segments.src: This effect is commonly called "bracket creep."
segments.tr: この現象は一般に「ブラケット・クリープ」と呼ばれます。

segments.src: To prevent it, federal law requires many tax parameters to be indexed to inflation each year.
segments.tr: これを防ぐため、連邦法では多くの税務パラメータを毎年インフレに連動させることが義務付けられています。

segments.src: The IRS uses a price index, the chained Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (C-CPI-U), to calculate the changes.
segments.tr: IRSは価格指数である連鎖消費者物価指数（C-CPI-U）を用いて変動幅を算出します。

segments.src: The result is that thresholds generally move up in line with measured price growth, which helps keep your tax burden tied to real income rather than nominal income.
segments.tr: その結果、所得基準は一般に計測された物価上昇に合わせて引き上げられ、税負担を名目所得ではなく実質所得に連動させる役割を果たします。

segments.src: ## What gets adjusted
segments.tr: ## 調整される項目

segments.src: The annual update covers a long list of items.
segments.tr: 毎年の改定では多くの項目が対象となります。

segments.src: The ones most households notice include:
segments.tr: 多くの世帯が特に気づく項目は次のとおりです：

segments.src: - **Tax bracket thresholds.** The income ranges for each marginal rate (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35% and 37%) move up. The rates themselves do not change through this process.
segments.tr: - **税率区分の基準額。** 各限界税率（10%、12%、22%、24%、32%、35%、37%）に対応する所得範囲が引き上げられます。税率そのものはこの過程で変わることはありません。

segments.src: - **The standard deduction.** For tax year 2026, the IRS set it at $16,100 for single filers and $32,200 for married couples filing jointly. Expect a modest increase for 2027.
segments.tr: - **標準控除。** 2026年課税年度において、IRSは独身申告者に16,100ドル、夫婦合算申告者に32,200ドルと定めました。2027年も小幅な増額が見込まれます。

segments.src: - **Retirement contribution limits.** For 2026, the 401(k) employee deferral limit is $24,500, with higher catch-up amounts for older workers. IRA limits are adjusted as well, though in increments that depend on rounding rules.
segments.tr: - **退職金拠出上限。** 2026年の401(k)における従業員の繰延上限は24,500ドルで、高齢の労働者にはさらに多くのキャッチアップ拠出額が認められています。IRAの上限も調整されますが、その増額幅は端数処理のルールによって異なります。

segments.src: - **Other items.** Income thresholds for certain credits, the Alternative Minimum Tax exemption, the annual gift tax exclusion, and flexible spending account limits are also indexed.
segments.tr: - **その他の項目。** 特定の税額控除の所得基準、代替ミニマム税（AMT）の控除額、年間贈与税の非課税限度額、柔軟支出口座（FSA）の上限も、インフレ連動の対象です。

segments.src: ## A simple example of how brackets work
segments.tr: ## 税率区分の仕組みの簡単な例

segments.src: Brackets are marginal.
segments.tr: 税率区分は限界的に適用されます。

segments.src: Moving into a higher bracket does not mean all of your income is taxed at the higher rate.
segments.tr: より高い税率区分に移ったからといって、所得全体が高い税率で課税されるわけではありません。

segments.src: Only the income above the threshold is taxed at that rate.
segments.tr: その税率が適用されるのは、基準額を超えた部分の所得だけです。

segments.src: Suppose a bracket begins at $50,000 this year and, after indexing, begins at $51,500 next year.
segments.tr: ある区分が今年は50,000ドルから始まり、インデックス化後には翌年51,500ドルから始まるとします。

segments.src: A taxpayer with $51,000 of taxable income would see part of that income taxed at the lower rate in the new year that was taxed at the higher rate before.
segments.tr: 課税所得が51,000ドルの納税者は、以前は高い税率で課税されていた所得の一部が、翌年には低い税率で課税されることになります。

segments.src: The effect on any one person is usually small, often tens or a few hundred dollars, but it adds up across a full year of paychecks.
segments.tr: 個人への影響は通常小さく、数十ドルから数百ドル程度ですが、1年分の給与で見ると積み重なります。

segments.src: ## What it means for your paycheck
segments.tr: ## 給与明細への影響

segments.src: Employers use IRS withholding tables to decide how much federal income tax to take from each paycheck.
segments.tr: 雇用主は、IRSの源泉徴収税額表を使って各給与から連邦所得税をいくら控除するかを決定します。

segments.src: When the thresholds and standard deduction rise, those tables are updated, and your take-home pay may increase slightly, assuming your salary stays the same.
segments.tr: 基準額や標準控除が引き上げられると、これらの表も更新され、給与が変わらなければ手取り額がわずかに増える可能性があります。

segments.src: If you receive a raise that outpaces inflation, however, more of your income can still land in higher brackets.
segments.tr: ただし、インフレ率を上回る昇給があれば、所得の一部はやはり高い税率区分に入る可能性があります。

segments.src: Indexing protects you from inflation alone, not from real income growth.
segments.tr: インデックス化が守ってくれるのは物価上昇による影響であり、実質所得の増加による影響ではありません。

segments.src: A year with a large raise, a bonus, a side business, or investment gains can still change your overall tax picture.
segments.tr: 大幅な昇給、賞与、副業、投資収益がある年は、全体の税負担が変わることがあります。

segments.src: ## What it means for 401(k) and retirement planning
segments.tr: ## 401(k)と退職計画への影響

segments.src: Higher contribution limits give savers more room to defer income.
segments.tr: 拠出上限が高くなると、貯蓄する人はより多くの所得を繰り延べられます。

segments.src: Contributing more to a traditional 401(k) lowers your taxable income for the year, while Roth contributions do not give an upfront deduction but allow qualified withdrawals later without federal income tax.
segments.tr: 従来型の401(k)への拠出を増やすと、その年の課税所得が下がります。一方、Roth拠出には当年の控除はありませんが、将来の適格な引き出しであれば連邦所得税なしで受け取れます。

segments.src: A few points worth considering:
segments.tr: 検討すべき点はいくつかあります：

segments.src: - **Check your contribution percentage.** If your plan takes a percentage of pay, a raise or a higher limit may not change how much you actually save. If you want to use the full new limit, you may need to raise your election.
segments.tr: - **拠出率を確認する。** 制度が給与の一定割合を拠出する仕組みであれば、昇給や上限の引き上げがあっても実際の貯蓄額は変わらない場合があります。新しい上限をフルに活用したい場合は、拠出率の設定を引き上げる必要があるかもしれません。

segments.src: - **Know the catch-up rules.** Workers age 50 and older can contribute extra amounts, and recent rules provide an even larger catch-up for certain ages. Some higher earners may be required to make catch-up contributions as Roth. Ask your plan administrator how it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **キャッチアップ・ルールを把握する。** 50歳以上の労働者は追加拠出が可能で、近年のルールでは特定の年齢にはさらに大きなキャッチアップが認められています。高所得者の一部は、キャッチアップ拠出をRothで行うことが義務付けられる場合があります。自分への適用内容については制度の管理者に確認してください。

segments.src: - **Confirm your employer match.** Make sure you are contributing enough to receive the full match your employer offers, since that is typically the most valuable benefit in the plan.
segments.tr: - **雇用主のマッチングを確認する。** 雇用主が提供する全額マッチングを受けられるよう十分に拠出しているか確認してください。これは通常、制度の中で最も価値の高い給付だからです。

segments.src: ## What to check before year-end
segments.tr: ## 年末前に確認すること

segments.src: The new thresholds apply to the next tax year, but your current-year decisions still matter.
segments.tr: 新しい基準額は翌課税年度から適用されますが、当年の判断も依然として重要です。

segments.src: A short checklist:
segments.tr: 簡単なチェックリストは次のとおりです：

segments.src: 1. **Review your withholding.** Use the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator to see whether you are on track to owe or receive a refund, and update your Form W-4 if needed.
segments.tr: 1. **源泉徴収額を見直す。** IRSの「Tax Withholding Estimator」を使って、税金を追加で支払うことになるか、還付を受けられるかを確認し、必要であればForm W-4を更新してください。

segments.src: 2. **Maximize or adjust retirement contributions.** Employer plan deferrals generally must be made by December 31. IRA contributions can usually be made until the tax filing deadline.
segments.tr: 2. **退職金拠出を最大化または調整する。** 雇用主の制度への繰延拠出は、通常12月31日までに行う必要があります。IRAへの拠出は、通常、税務申告期限まで行うことができます。

segments.src: 3. **Use flexible spending accounts.** Some FSA balances are subject to use-it-or-lose-it rules, so check your plan's deadline and any carryover allowance.
segments.tr: 3. **柔軟支出口座を活用する。** FSAの残高には「使い切り」ルールが適用される場合があるため、制度の期限と繰越許容額を確認してください。

segments.src: 4. **Look at investment gains and losses.** Selling losing positions can offset gains. Consider the timing of any large sale.
segments.tr: 4. **投資の利益と損失を確認する。** 含み損のある銘柄を売却すると、利益と相殺できます。大きな売却のタイミングも検討してください。

segments.src: 5. **Consider charitable giving.** If you itemize or use a donor-advised fund, year-end is a common time to plan donations.
segments.tr: 5. **寄付を検討する。** 項目別控除を利用する場合や寄付助言ファンドを利用する場合、年末は寄付を計画する一般的な時期です。

segments.src: 6. **Estimate next year's income.** If you expect a major change, such as a new job, retirement, or a sale of property, consider how the new brackets may affect you.
segments.tr: 6. **来年の所得を見積もる。** 転職、退職、不動産売却などの大きな変化が予想される場合は、新しい税率区分がどのように影響するかを検討してください。

segments.src: 7. **Update estimated payments.** Self-employed workers and others with income not subject to withholding should check whether their fourth-quarter payment is on track.

segments.src: ## Keep it in perspective
segments.tr: ## 全体像を把握する

segments.src: Inflation adjustments are not a tax cut or a tax increase.

de.title: 2027 Steuerstufen: Wie Inflationsanpassungen verändern, was Sie zahlen

segments.src: Every autumn, the Internal Revenue Service publishes updated federal tax figures for the coming year.
segments.tr: Jeden Herbst veröffentlicht der Internal Revenue Service (IRS) aktualisierte bundesweite Steuerwerte für das kommende Jahr.

segments.src: The announcement is routine, but it affects almost every household: the income thresholds for each tax bracket, the standard deduction, and the contribution limits for retirement accounts all shift.
segments.tr: Die Ankündigung ist routinemäßig, betrifft aber nahezu jeden Haushalt: die Einkommensgrenzen für jede Steuerstufe, der Standardabzug und die Beitragsgrenzen für Altersvorsorgekonten verschieben sich.

segments.src: This explainer covers how those inflation adjustments work, why they matter for your paycheck and retirement planning, and what to review before the year ends.
segments.tr: Dieser Leitfaden erklärt, wie diese Inflationsanpassungen funktionieren, warum sie für Ihr Gehalt und Ihre Altersvorsorgeplanung wichtig sind und was Sie vor Jahresende prüfen sollten.

segments.src: *Note: The IRS typically releases the next year's figures in October or early November.
segments.tr: *Hinweis: Der IRS veröffentlicht die Werte für das nächste Jahr üblicherweise im Oktober oder Anfang November.

segments.src: At the time of writing, check IRS.gov for the official 2027 numbers.
segments.tr: Prüfen Sie zum Zeitpunkt der Erstellung auf IRS.gov die offiziellen Zahlen für 2027.

segments.src: The 2026 figures cited below are used as a reference point and should be verified against current IRS guidance.*
segments.tr: Die unten genannten Werte für 2026 dienen als Referenzpunkt und sollten anhand der aktuellen IRS-Richtlinien überprüft werden.*

segments.src: ## Why the IRS adjusts for inflation
segments.tr: ## Warum der IRS Inflationsanpassungen vornimmt

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Das US-Steuersystem

segments.src: tax system uses a progressive structure: income is taxed in layers, and each layer has its own rate.
segments.tr: arbeitet mit einer progressiven Struktur: Einkommen wird in Schichten besteuert, und jede Schicht hat ihren eigenen Satz.

segments.src: Without adjustments, rising prices and wages would slowly push taxpayers into higher brackets even when their purchasing power had not improved.
segments.tr: Ohne Anpassungen würden steigende Preise und Löhne Steuerpflichtige langsam in höhere Stufen drängen, selbst wenn sich ihre Kaufkraft nicht verbessert hätte.

segments.src: This effect is commonly called "bracket creep."
segments.tr: Dieser Effekt wird üblicherweise als „kalte Progression“ bezeichnet.

segments.src: To prevent it, federal law requires many tax parameters to be indexed to inflation each year.
segments.tr: Um dies zu verhindern, verlangt das US-Bundesrecht, dass viele Steuerparameter jedes Jahr an die Inflation gekoppelt werden.

segments.src: The IRS uses a price index, the chained Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (C-CPI-U), to calculate the changes.
segments.tr: Der IRS verwendet dafür einen Preisindex, den Chained Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (C-CPI-U), um die Veränderungen zu berechnen.

segments.src: The result is that thresholds generally move up in line with measured price growth, which helps keep your tax burden tied to real income rather than nominal income.
segments.tr: Das Ergebnis ist, dass Schwellenwerte im Allgemeinen parallel zum gemessenen Preisanstieg steigen. So bleibt Ihre Steuerlast eher an das reale statt an das nominale Einkommen gebunden.

segments.src: ## What gets adjusted
segments.tr: ## Was angepasst wird

segments.src: The annual update covers a long list of items.
segments.tr: Die jährliche Aktualisierung umfasst eine lange Liste von Positionen.

segments.src: The ones most households notice include:
segments.tr: Die Positionen, die die meisten Haushalte bemerken, sind:

segments.src: - **Tax bracket thresholds.** The income ranges for each marginal rate (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35% and 37%) move up. The rates themselves do not change through this process.
segments.tr: - **Schwellenwerte der Steuerstufen.** Die Einkommensspannen für jeden Grenzsteuersatz (10 %, 12 %, 22 %, 24 %, 32 %, 35 % und 37 %) steigen. Die Steuersätze selbst ändern sich durch diesen Prozess nicht.

segments.src: - **The standard deduction.** For tax year 2026, the IRS set it at $16,100 for single filers and $32,200 for married couples filing jointly. Expect a modest increase for 2027.
segments.tr: - **Der Standardabzug.** Für das Steuerjahr 2026 hat der IRS ihn auf $16,100 für Alleinveranlagte und $32,200 für zusammen veranlagte Ehepaare festgelegt. Für 2027 ist ein moderater Anstieg zu erwarten.

segments.src: - **Retirement contribution limits.** For 2026, the 401(k) employee deferral limit is $24,500, with higher catch-up amounts for older workers. IRA limits are adjusted as well, though in increments that depend on rounding rules.
segments.tr: - **Beitragsgrenzen für die Altersvorsorge.** Für 2026 beträgt die Grenze für Arbeitnehmerbeiträge zum 401(k) $24,500, mit höheren Nachholbeträgen für ältere Arbeitnehmer. Auch die IRA-Grenzen werden angepasst, allerdings in Schritten, die von Rundungsregeln abhängen.

segments.src: - **Other items.** Income thresholds for certain credits, the Alternative Minimum Tax exemption, the annual gift tax exclusion, and flexible spending account limits are also indexed.
segments.tr: - **Weitere Positionen.** Einkommensgrenzen für bestimmte Steuergutschriften, die Freibetragsgrenze der Alternative Minimum Tax, die jährliche Schenkungssteuer-Freigrenze und die Grenzen für Flexible Spending Accounts werden ebenfalls indexiert.

segments.src: ## A simple example of how brackets work
segments.tr: ## Ein einfaches Beispiel für die Funktionsweise der Steuerstufen

segments.src: Brackets are marginal.
segments.tr: Steuerstufen wirken marginal.

segments.src: Moving into a higher bracket does not mean all of your income is taxed at the higher rate.
segments.tr: Der Wechsel in eine höhere Stufe bedeutet nicht, dass Ihr gesamtes Einkommen zum höheren Satz besteuert wird.

segments.src: Only the income above the threshold is taxed at that rate.
segments.tr: Nur der Teil des Einkommens über der Schwelle wird zu diesem Satz besteuert.

segments.src: Suppose a bracket begins at $50,000 this year and, after indexing, begins at $51,500 next year.
segments.tr: Angenommen, eine Stufe beginnt in diesem Jahr bei $50,000 und nach der Indexierung im nächsten Jahr bei $51,500.

segments.src: A taxpayer with $51,000 of taxable income would see part of that income taxed at the lower rate in the new year that was taxed at the higher rate before.
segments.tr: Ein Steuerpflichtiger mit einem zu versteuernden Einkommen von $51,000 würde einen Teil dieses Einkommens, der zuvor zum höheren Satz besteuert wurde, im neuen Jahr zum niedrigeren Satz besteuert sehen.

segments.src: The effect on any one person is usually small, often tens or a few hundred dollars, but it adds up across a full year of paychecks.
segments.tr: Die Auswirkung auf eine einzelne Person ist meist gering, oft einige Dutzend oder wenige hundert Dollar, summiert sich aber über ein ganzes Jahr an Gehaltsabrechnungen.

segments.src: ## What it means for your paycheck
segments.tr: ## Was es für Ihre Gehaltsabrechnung bedeutet

segments.src: Employers use IRS withholding tables to decide how much federal income tax to take from each paycheck.
segments.tr: Arbeitgeber nutzen IRS-Lohnsteuertabellen, um zu bestimmen, wie viel Bundeseinkommensteuer von jeder Gehaltsabrechnung abgezogen wird.

segments.src: When the thresholds and standard deduction rise, those tables are updated, and your take-home pay may increase slightly, assuming your salary stays the same.
segments.tr: Wenn die Schwellenwerte und der Standardabzug steigen, werden diese Tabellen aktualisiert, und Ihr Nettolohn kann sich leicht erhöhen, sofern Ihr Gehalt gleich bleibt.

segments.src: If you receive a raise that outpaces inflation, however, more of your income can still land in higher brackets.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie jedoch eine Gehaltserhöhung erhalten, die die Inflation übertrifft, können dennoch mehr Ihres Einkommens in höhere Stufen fallen.

segments.src: Indexing protects you from inflation alone, not from real income growth.
segments.tr: Die Indexierung schützt Sie nur vor der Inflation, nicht vor realem Einkommenswachstum.

segments.src: A year with a large raise, a bonus, a side business, or investment gains can still change your overall tax picture.
segments.tr: Ein Jahr mit einer großen Gehaltserhöhung, einem Bonus, einem Nebengewerbe oder Kapitalgewinnen kann Ihr gesamtes Steuerbild dennoch verändern.

segments.src: ## What it means for 401(k) and retirement planning
segments.tr: ## Was es für 401(k) und Altersvorsorgeplanung bedeutet

segments.src: Higher contribution limits give savers more room to defer income.
segments.tr: Höhere Beitragsgrenzen geben Sparern mehr Spielraum, Einkommen aufzuschieben.

segments.src: Contributing more to a traditional 401(k) lowers your taxable income for the year, while Roth contributions do not give an upfront deduction but allow qualified withdrawals later without federal income tax.
segments.tr: Mehr in ein traditionelles 401(k) einzuzahlen senkt Ihr zu versteuerndes Einkommen für das Jahr, während Roth-Beiträge keinen sofortigen Abzug bringen, aber qualifizierte Auszahlungen später ohne Bundeseinkommensteuer ermöglichen.

segments.src: A few points worth considering:
segments.tr: Einige Punkte sind es wert, bedacht zu werden:

segments.src: - **Check your contribution percentage.** If your plan takes a percentage of pay, a raise or a higher limit may not change how much you actually save. If you want to use the full new limit, you may need to raise your election.
segments.tr: - **Prüfen Sie Ihren Beitragsprozentsatz.** Wenn Ihr Plan einen Prozentsatz Ihres Gehalts abzieht, ändert eine Gehaltserhöhung oder eine höhere Grenze möglicherweise nicht, wie viel Sie tatsächlich sparen. Wenn Sie die volle neue Grenze nutzen möchten, müssen Sie Ihre Auswahl eventuell erhöhen.

segments.src: - **Know the catch-up rules.** Workers age 50 and older can contribute extra amounts, and recent rules provide an even larger catch-up for certain ages. Some higher earners may be required to make catch-up contributions as Roth. Ask your plan administrator how it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **Kennen Sie die Nachholregeln.** Arbeitnehmer ab 50 Jahren können zusätzliche Beträge einzahlen, und neuere Regeln sehen für bestimmte Altersgruppen einen noch größeren Nachholbetrag vor. Manche Besserverdienende müssen Nachholbeiträge möglicherweise als Roth leisten. Fragen Sie Ihren Planverwalter, wie dies für Sie gilt.

segments.src: - **Confirm your employer match.** Make sure you are contributing enough to receive the full match your employer offers, since that is typically the most valuable benefit in the plan.
segments.tr: - **Prüfen Sie Ihren Arbeitgeberzuschuss.** Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie genug einzahlen, um den vollen Zuschuss Ihres Arbeitgebers zu erhalten, da dies typischerweise der wertvollste Vorteil im Plan ist.

segments.src: ## What to check before year-end
segments.tr: ## Was Sie vor Jahresende prüfen sollten

segments.src: The new thresholds apply to the next tax year, but your current-year decisions still matter.
segments.tr: Die neuen Schwellenwerte gelten für das nächste Steuerjahr, aber Ihre Entscheidungen im laufenden Jahr sind weiterhin wichtig.

segments.src: A short checklist:
segments.tr: Eine kurze Checkliste:

segments.src: 1. **Review your withholding.** Use the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator to see whether you are on track to owe or receive a refund, and update your Form W-4 if needed.
segments.tr: 1. **Prüfen Sie Ihre Lohnsteuereinbehalte.** Nutzen Sie den IRS Tax Withholding Estimator, um zu sehen, ob Sie voraussichtlich nachzahlen oder eine Erstattung erhalten, und aktualisieren Sie bei Bedarf Ihr Formular W-4.

segments.src: 2. **Maximize or adjust retirement contributions.** Employer plan deferrals generally must be made by December 31. IRA contributions can usually be made until the tax filing deadline.
segments.tr: 2. **Altersvorsorgebeiträge maximieren oder anpassen.** Einzahlungen in Arbeitgeberpläne müssen in der Regel bis zum 31. Dezember erfolgt sein. IRA-Beiträge können meist bis zum Steuerabgabetermin geleistet werden.

segments.src: 3. **Use flexible spending accounts.** Some FSA balances are subject to use-it-or-lose-it rules, so check your plan's deadline and any carryover allowance.
segments.tr: 3. **Flexible Spending Accounts nutzen.** Einige FSA-Guthaben unterliegen „Use it or lose it“-Regeln. Prüfen Sie daher die Frist Ihres Plans und mögliche Übertragungsregelungen.

segments.src: 4. **Look at investment gains and losses.** Selling losing positions can offset gains. Consider the timing of any large sale.
segments.tr: 4. **Kapitalgewinne und -verluste prüfen.** Der Verkauf verlustbringender Positionen kann Gewinne ausgleichen. Bedenken Sie den Zeitpunkt eines größeren Verkaufs.

segments.src: 5. **Consider charitable giving.** If you itemize or use a donor-advised fund, year-end is a common time to plan donations.
segments.tr: 5. **Spenden in Erwägung ziehen.** Wenn Sie Ausgaben einzeln absetzen oder einen Donor-Advised Fund nutzen, ist das Jahresende ein üblicher Zeitpunkt, um Spenden zu planen.

segments.src: 6. **Estimate next year's income.** If you expect a major change, such as a new job, retirement, or a sale of property, consider how the new brackets may affect you.
segments.tr: 6. **Das Einkommen für nächstes Jahr schätzen.** Wenn Sie eine große Veränderung erwarten, etwa einen neuen Job, den Ruhestand oder den Verkauf von Immobilien, überlegen Sie, wie sich die neuen Stufen auf Sie auswirken könnten.

segments.src: 7. **Update estimated payments.** Self-employed workers and others with income not subject to withholding should check whether their fourth-quarter payment is on track.
segments.tr: 7. **Vorauszahlungen aktualisieren.** Selbstständige und andere mit Einkommen ohne Lohnsteuerabzug sollten prüfen, ob ihre Vorauszahlung für das vierte Quartal im Plan liegt.

segments.tr: ## Die Sache im Blick behalten

segments.src: ## Why the IRS adjusts for inflation
segments.tr: ## Vì sao IRS điều chỉnh theo lạm phát

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Hệ thống thuế của Hoa Kỳ

segments.tr: áp dụng cơ chế lũy tiến: thu nhập được đánh thuế theo từng lớp, và mỗi lớp có thuế suất riêng.

segments.src: Without adjustments, rising prices and wages would slowly push taxpayers into higher brackets even when their purchasing power had not improved.
segments.tr: Nếu không điều chỉnh, giá cả và tiền lương tăng sẽ dần đẩy người nộp thuế lên các bậc cao hơn, ngay cả khi sức mua thực tế của họ không được cải thiện.

segments.src: This effect is commonly called "bracket creep."
segments.tr: Hiệu ứng này thường được gọi là "bracket creep" (trượt bậc thuế).

segments.src: To prevent it, federal law requires many tax parameters to be indexed to inflation each year.
segments.tr: Để ngăn chặn điều này, luật liên bang yêu cầu nhiều thông số thuế phải được điều chỉnh theo lạm phát mỗi năm.

segments.src: The IRS uses a price index, the chained Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (C-CPI-U), to calculate the changes.
segments.tr: IRS sử dụng một chỉ số giá, chỉ số giá tiêu dùng chuỗi cho người tiêu dùng thành thị (C-CPI-U), để tính toán các thay đổi.

segments.src: The result is that thresholds generally move up in line with measured price growth, which helps keep your tax burden tied to real income rather than nominal income.
segments.tr: Kết quả là các ngưỡng nhìn chung tăng theo mức tăng giá đo được, giúp gánh nặng thuế của bạn gắn với thu nhập thực tế thay vì thu nhập danh nghĩa.

segments.src: ## What gets adjusted
segments.tr: ## Những gì được điều chỉnh

segments.src: The annual update covers a long list of items.
segments.tr: Bản cập nhật hằng năm bao gồm một danh sách dài các hạng mục.

segments.src: The ones most households notice include:
segments.tr: Những hạng mục mà phần lớn hộ gia đình nhận thấy gồm:

segments.src: - **Tax bracket thresholds.** The income ranges for each marginal rate (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35% and 37%) move up. The rates themselves do not change through this process.
segments.tr: - **Ngưỡng các bậc thuế.** Khoảng thu nhập cho từng thuế suất biên (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35% và 37%) tăng lên. Bản thân thuế suất không thay đổi thông qua quá trình này.

segments.src: - **The standard deduction.** For tax year 2026, the IRS set it at $16,100 for single filers and $32,200 for married couples filing jointly. Expect a modest increase for 2027.
segments.tr: - **Khoản khấu trừ tiêu chuẩn.** Đối với năm thuế 2026, IRS đặt mức này là $16,100 cho người nộp thuế độc thân và $32,200 cho các cặp vợ chồng nộp thuế chung. Dự kiến sẽ tăng nhẹ trong năm 2027.

segments.src: - **Retirement contribution limits.** For 2026, the 401(k) employee deferral limit is $24,500, with higher catch-up amounts for older workers. IRA limits are adjusted as well, though in increments that depend on rounding rules.
segments.tr: - **Hạn mức đóng góp hưu trí.** Đối với năm 2026, hạn mức đóng góp của nhân viên vào 401(k) là $24,500, với mức đóng bổ sung cao hơn dành cho người lao động lớn tuổi. Hạn mức IRA cũng được điều chỉnh, dù theo các bước làm tròn tùy thuộc vào quy tắc làm tròn.

segments.src: - **Other items.** Income thresholds for certain credits, the Alternative Minimum Tax exemption, the annual gift tax exclusion, and flexible spending account limits are also indexed.
segments.tr: - **Các hạng mục khác.** Ngưỡng thu nhập cho một số khoản tín dụng thuế, mức miễn trừ Thuế Tối thiểu Thay thế (Alternative Minimum Tax), mức miễn trừ thuế quà tặng hằng năm và hạn mức tài khoản chi tiêu linh hoạt (FSA) cũng được điều chỉnh theo chỉ số.

segments.src: ## A simple example of how brackets work
segments.tr: ## Ví dụ đơn giản về cách hoạt động của các bậc thuế

segments.src: Brackets are marginal.
segments.tr: Các bậc thuế mang tính biên.

segments.src: Moving into a higher bracket does not mean all of your income is taxed at the higher rate.
segments.tr: Việc chuyển sang bậc thuế cao hơn không có nghĩa là toàn bộ thu nhập của bạn bị đánh thuế theo thuế suất cao hơn.

segments.src: Only the income above the threshold is taxed at that rate.
segments.tr: Chỉ phần thu nhập vượt quá ngưỡng mới bị đánh thuế theo thuế suất đó.

segments.src: Suppose a bracket begins at $50,000 this year and, after indexing, begins at $51,500 next year.
segments.tr: Giả sử một bậc thuế bắt đầu từ $50,000 trong năm nay và sau khi điều chỉnh theo chỉ số sẽ bắt đầu từ $51,500 vào năm tới.

segments.src: A taxpayer with $51,000 of taxable income would see part of that income taxed at the lower rate in the new year that was taxed at the higher rate before.
segments.tr: Một người nộp thuế có thu nhập chịu thuế $51,000 sẽ thấy một phần thu nhập đó được đánh thuế theo thuế suất thấp hơn trong năm mới, trong khi trước đây phần đó bị đánh theo thuế suất cao hơn.

segments.src: The effect on any one person is usually small, often tens or a few hundred dollars, but it adds up across a full year of paychecks.
segments.tr: Tác động đối với mỗi cá nhân thường nhỏ, thường chỉ vài chục hoặc vài trăm đô la, nhưng cộng dồn lại qua cả năm trả lương.

segments.src: ## What it means for your paycheck
segments.tr: ## Ý nghĩa đối với tiền lương hằng kỳ của bạn

segments.src: Employers use IRS withholding tables to decide how much federal income tax to take from each paycheck.
segments.tr: Người sử dụng lao động dùng bảng khấu trừ thuế (withholding tables) của IRS để quyết định số thuế thu nhập liên bang cần khấu trừ từ mỗi kỳ lương.

segments.src: When the thresholds and standard deduction rise, those tables are updated, and your take-home pay may increase slightly, assuming your salary stays the same.
segments.tr: Khi ngưỡng và khoản khấu trừ tiêu chuẩn tăng lên, các bảng này được cập nhật, và tiền lương thực nhận của bạn có thể tăng nhẹ, với điều kiện mức lương không đổi.

segments.src: If you receive a raise that outpaces inflation, however, more of your income can still land in higher brackets.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, nếu bạn được tăng lương vượt mức lạm phát, nhiều thu nhập hơn vẫn có thể rơi vào các bậc thuế cao hơn.

segments.src: Indexing protects you from inflation alone, not from real income growth.
segments.tr: Điều chỉnh theo chỉ số chỉ bảo vệ bạn khỏi lạm phát, chứ không bảo vệ khỏi tăng trưởng thu nhập thực tế.

segments.src: A year with a large raise, a bonus, a side business, or investment gains can still change your overall tax picture.
segments.tr: Một năm có mức tăng lương lớn, tiền thưởng, thu nhập từ kinh doanh phụ hoặc lợi nhuận đầu tư vẫn có thể thay đổi bức tranh thuế tổng thể của bạn.

segments.src: ## What it means for 401(k) and retirement planning
segments.tr: ## Ý nghĩa đối với 401(k) và kế hoạch hưu trí

segments.src: Higher contribution limits give savers more room to defer income.
segments.tr: Hạn mức đóng góp cao hơn cho người tiết kiệm thêm không gian để trì hoãn thu nhập.

segments.src: Contributing more to a traditional 401(k) lowers your taxable income for the year, while Roth contributions do not give an upfront deduction but allow qualified withdrawals later without federal income tax.
segments.tr: Đóng góp nhiều hơn vào 401(k) truyền thống sẽ làm giảm thu nhập chịu thuế trong năm, trong khi các khoản đóng góp Roth không được khấu trừ ngay nhưng cho phép rút tiền đủ điều kiện về sau mà không chịu thuế thu nhập liên bang.

segments.src: A few points worth considering:
segments.tr: Một số điểm đáng cân nhắc:

segments.src: - **Check your contribution percentage.** If your plan takes a percentage of pay, a raise or a higher limit may not change how much you actually save. If you want to use the full new limit, you may need to raise your election.
segments.tr: - **Kiểm tra tỷ lệ đóng góp của bạn.** Nếu kế hoạch trích một tỷ lệ phần trăm từ lương, việc tăng lương hoặc hạn mức cao hơn có thể không thay đổi số tiền bạn thực sự tiết kiệm. Nếu muốn sử dụng toàn bộ hạn mức mới, bạn có thể cần tăng mức đăng ký của mình.

segments.src: - **Know the catch-up rules.** Workers age 50 and older can contribute extra amounts, and recent rules provide an even larger catch-up for certain ages. Some higher earners may be required to make catch-up contributions as Roth. Ask your plan administrator how it applies to you.
segments.tr: - **Nắm rõ quy tắc đóng bổ sung.** Người lao động từ 50 tuổi trở lên có thể đóng thêm, và các quy định gần đây cho phép mức bổ sung lớn hơn đối với một số độ tuổi nhất định. Một số người có thu nhập cao có thể bị yêu cầu đóng phần bổ sung dưới dạng Roth. Hãy hỏi quản trị viên kế hoạch của bạn cách áp dụng cho trường hợp của mình.

segments.src: - **Confirm your employer match.** Make sure you are contributing enough to receive the full match your employer offers, since that is typically the most valuable benefit in the plan.
segments.tr: - **Xác nhận khoản đối ứng của người sử dụng lao động.** Hãy chắc chắn bạn đang đóng đủ để nhận toàn bộ khoản đối ứng mà người sử dụng lao động cung cấp, vì đó thường là lợi ích có giá trị nhất trong kế hoạch.

segments.src: ## What to check before year-end
segments.tr: ## Những gì cần kiểm tra trước cuối năm

segments.src: The new thresholds apply to the next tax year, but your current-year decisions still matter.
segments.tr: Các ngưỡng mới áp dụng cho năm thuế tiếp theo, nhưng các quyết định trong năm hiện tại vẫn quan trọng.

segments.src: A short checklist:
segments.tr: Danh sách kiểm tra ngắn:

segments.src: 1. **Review your withholding.** Use the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator to see whether you are on track to owe or receive a refund, and update your Form W-4 if needed.
segments.tr: 1. **Xem lại khấu trừ thuế (withholding) của bạn.** Dùng Công cụ Ước tính Khấu trừ Thuế của IRS để xem bạn đang trên đà nợ thuế hay được hoàn thuế, và cập nhật Mẫu W-4 nếu cần.

segments.src: 2. **Maximize or adjust retirement contributions.** Employer plan deferrals generally must be made by December 31. IRA contributions can usually be made until the tax filing deadline.
segments.tr: 2. **Tối đa hóa hoặc điều chỉnh đóng góp hưu trí.** Khoản trì hoãn trong kế hoạch của người sử dụng lao động thường phải thực hiện trước ngày 31 tháng 12. Đóng góp IRA thường có thể thực hiện đến hạn nộp tờ khai thuế.

segments.src: 3. **Use flexible spending accounts.** Some FSA balances are subject to use-it-or-lose-it rules, so check your plan's deadline and any carryover allowance.
segments.tr: 3. **Sử dụng tài khoản chi tiêu linh hoạt.** Một số số dư FSA phải dùng hết trong năm (use-it-or-lose-it), vì vậy hãy kiểm tra hạn chót của kế hoạch và mọi hạn mức chuyển tiếp.

segments.src: 4. **Look at investment gains and losses.** Selling losing positions can offset gains. Consider the timing of any large sale.
segments.tr: 4. **Xem xét lãi và lỗ đầu tư.** Bán các khoản đầu tư đang lỗ có thể bù trừ lợi nhuận. Hãy cân nhắc thời điểm của bất kỳ giao dịch bán lớn nào.

segments.src: 5. **Consider charitable giving.** If you itemize or use a donor-advised fund, year-end is a common time to plan donations.
segments.tr: 5. **Cân nhắc quyên góp từ thiện.** Nếu bạn kê khai chi tiết (itemize) hoặc sử dụng quỹ tư vấn của nhà tài trợ (donor-advised fund), cuối năm là thời điểm phổ biến để lên kế hoạch quyên góp.

segments.src: 6. **Estimate next year's income.** If you expect a major change, such as a new job, retirement, or a sale of property, consider how the new brackets may affect you.
segments.tr: 6. **Ước tính thu nhập năm tới.** Nếu bạn dự kiến có thay đổi lớn, chẳng hạn công việc mới, nghỉ hưu hoặc bán tài sản, hãy cân nhắc các bậc thuế mới có thể ảnh hưởng đến bạn ra sao.

segments.src: 7. **Update estimated payments.** Self-employed workers and others with income not subject to withholding should check whether their fourth-quarter payment is on track.
segments.tr: 7. **Cập nhật các khoản thanh toán ước tính.** Người tự kinh doanh và những người có thu nhập không bị khấu trừ thuế nên kiểm tra xem khoản thanh toán quý IV của mình có đúng tiến độ không.

segments.src: ## Keep it in perspective
segments.tr: ## Giữ đúng góc nhìn

segments.src: Inflation adjustments are not a tax cut or a tax increase.
segments.tr: Điều chỉnh theo lạm phát không phải là giảm thuế hay tăng thuế.

segments.src: They are designed to keep the tax system neutral against rising prices.
segments.tr: Chúng được thiết kế để giữ cho hệ thống thuế trung lập trước giá cả tăng.

segments.src: Their practical effect is usually modest, but they matter most when you combine them with a clear view of your own income, deductions, and savings goals.
segments.tr: Tác động thực tế của chúng thường khá khiêm tốn, nhưng chúng quan trọng nhất khi bạn kết hợp với cái nhìn rõ ràng về thu nhập, khoản khấu trừ và mục tiêu tiết kiệm của chính mình.

segments.src: Because individual circumstances vary, consider speaking with a qualified tax professional before making major decisions.
segments.tr: Vì hoàn cảnh cá nhân khác nhau, bạn nên cân nhắc tham khảo ý kiến chuyên gia thuế có trình độ trước khi đưa ra các quyết định lớn.

segments.src: For official figures and guidance, rely on IRS.gov and the IRS announcement of the 2027 inflation adjustments when it is published.
segments.tr: Với các con số và hướng dẫn chính thức, hãy tham khảo IRS.gov và thông báo của IRS về các điều chỉnh lạm phát năm 2027 khi được công bố.
